weapons.name: Acquazzone
weapons.description:
The Acquazzone is a hidden weapon in Vampire Survivors. It is currently only used in the Ode to Castlevania DLC by the Ferryman and Atlantis Shrine Wizard. Para Kooleo also possesses a hidden copy of Acquazzone that temporarily activates whenever he evolves a weapon.
Acquazzone behaves similarly to The Drowner's attack by creating a zone of water filled with swirling bubbles on the bottom half of the screen. It flashes white when it strikes, damaging all enemies within the bottom half of the screen, and will pulse several times with damage based on Amount. The Acquazzone has a base damage of 10 and base Cooldown of 5 seconds.
This attack does not damage light sources.

weapons.name: Ammo Appalate
weapons.caption: Aims at an enemy in the faced direction. Stockpiles projectiles when enemies are out of range.
weapons.description:
Ammo Appalate is a weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors that was introduced in Patch 1.14. It is the starting weapon of Zi'Appunta Belpaese. It is unlocked by defeating a total of 251,096 shooting enemies.
Its evolution is Gunastrophe, which requires Bracer at max level. Evolving it unlocks Zi'Appunta Belpaese as playable character.

weapons.name: Anima of Mortaccio
weapons.caption: Evolved Bone. Projectiles accelerate when bouncing.
weapons.description:
Anima of Mortaccio is a morph from the base game version of Vampire Survivors that was introduced in Patch 1.3.0. It is the evolution of Bone, and requires Chaos Malachite relic and reaching level 80 while playing as Mortaccio.
Alternatively, it can be obtained via Cosmic Finger rewards from Gold Fingers or the Edition of Mortaccio's Survarocchi.
weapons.effects:
* Bounces from terrain and enemies.
* Scales with all stat bonuses.

weapons.name: Arma Dio
weapons.caption: Allows you to choose an extra passive weapon.
weapons.description: Arma Dio is a weapon selector from the base game version of Vampire Survivors that was introduced in Patch 1.10. It is unlocked by collecting it in any stage.
weapons.effects: Appearance in level up options affected by Luck.

weapons.name: Ashes of Muspell
weapons.caption: Evolved Flames of Misspell. The more enemies are defeated, the stronger it grows.
weapons.description: Ashes of Muspell is an evolved weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Flames of Misspell, requiring Torrona's Box at max level.

weapons.name: Axe
weapons.caption: High damage, high Area scaling.
weapons.description:
Axe is a weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Lama Ladonna and Axe Armor, and one of the starting weapons of missingN▯. It is unlocked by default.
Its evolution is Death Spiral, which requires Candelabrador.
As a vampire-killing tool, it can be picked from Coat of Arms.

weapons.name: Bi-Bracelet
weapons.caption: Fires three projectiles at a random enemy.
weapons.description:
Bi-Bracelet is an evolved weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors. It is evolved from Bracelet. The evolution does not require any passive items.
Its evolution is Tri-Bracelet, which does not require any passive item.

weapons.name: Bloody Tear
weapons.caption: Evolution of the whip. Can deal critical damage and absorb HP.
weapons.description:
Bloody Tear is an evolved weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Whip, and requires Hollow Heart. Evolving it for the first time will unlock 500 as reward.
Its union is Fuwalafuwaloo, which also requires Vento Sacro at max level.
It is the starting weapon of Minnah Mannarah.
weapons.effects:
*Ignores Duration and Speed.
*Luck increases crit chance.
*Restores 8 HP/attack if it hits any enemies with a crit.

weapons.name: Bone
weapons.caption: Throws a bouncing projectile.
weapons.description:
Bone is a weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Mortaccio and Fake Trevor. Other characters have a small chance to obtain it after Mortaccio is unlocked. It can also be obtained from Merchant in-game by spending 1,000, or by selecting this weapon from Candybox.
Its evolution is Anima of Mortaccio, which requires Chaos Malachite and reaching level 80 while playing as Mortaccio.
weapons.effects:
* Bounces from terrain and enemies.
* Scales with all stat bonuses.

weapons.name: Bracelet
weapons.caption: Fires three projectiles at a random enemy.
weapons.description:
Bracelet is a weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors that was introduced in Patch 0.9.0. It is the starting weapon of Gyorunton and Fake Sypha. It is unlocked by surviving 30 minutes with either Divano Thelma or Iguana Gallo Valletto.
Its evolution is Bi-Bracelet that can be further evolved into Tri-Bracelet, both of which do not require any passive item.

weapons.name: Candybox
weapons.caption: Allows you to choose any unlocked base weapon.
weapons.description:
Candybox is a weapon selector from the base game version of Vampire Survivors that was introduced in Patch 0.10.0. It is unlocked by discovering every standard evolution and union.
Its Gift is Super Candybox II Turbo, obtainable only when opening a Treasure Chest 2 after obtaining a Candybox.
It is the starting weapon of Big Trouser. Queen Sigma can also buy the Candybox from the Merchant for 1000, replacing the option to buy Golden Eggs.
weapons.effects: Occurrence in level up options affected by Luck.

weapons.name: Carréllo
weapons.caption: Throws a bouncing projectile. Number of bounces affected by Amount.
weapons.description:
Carréllo is a weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors that was introduced in Patch 0.4.2. It is the starting weapon of Bianca Ramba. Other characters have a small chance to obtain it after Bianca Ramba is unlocked. It can also be obtained from Merchant in-game by spending 1,000, by selecting this weapon from the Candybox, or as a chance from the Gold Finger Pickup when achieving the "Bronze Finger" tier.
Its evolution is Carrozza!, which requires Chaos Lazulia and reaching level 80 while playing as Bianca Ramba.

weapons.name: Carrozza!
weapons.caption: Evolved Carréllo. Duration, Speed, and Area affect damage instead.
weapons.description:
Carrozza! is a morph from the base game version of Vampire Survivors that was introduced in Patch 1.14. It is the evolution of Carréllo, and requires the Chaos Lazulia relic and reaching level 80 while playing as Bianca Ramba.
Alternatively, it can be obtained via Cosmic Finger rewards from Gold Fingers or the Edition of Bianca Ramba's Survarocchi.
weapons.effects:
* Carts bounce off of obstacles and the edge of the screen.
* Summons Take Us Away, alternating above and below the player.

weapons.name: Celestial Dusting
weapons.caption: Throws a bouncing projectile. Cooldown reduces when moving.
weapons.description:
Celestial Dusting is a weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors that was introduced in Patch 0.5.1. It is the starting weapon of O'Sole Meeo. Other characters have a small chance to obtain it after O'Sole Meeo is unlocked. It can also be obtained from Merchant in-game by spending 1,000, or by selecting this weapon from Candybox.
Its evolution is Profusione D'Amore, which requires Chaos Altemanna and reaching level 80 while playing as O'Sole Meeo.
weapons.effects:
* Ignores Speed.
* Generate little heart at max level.
* Scales with Move Speed when moving.

weapons.name: Celestial Voulge
weapons.caption: Evolved Glass Fandango. Might deal critical damage and freeze enemies. Turns Orologions into Starry Heavens.
weapons.description: Celestial Voulge is an evolved weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors that was introduced in Patch 1.7.0. It is the evolution of Glass Fandango, and requires Wings at max level. Evolving it for the first time will unlock 500 as reward.
weapons.effects:
* Ignores Duration and Speed.
* 5% chance to freeze enemies.
* Luck increases critical hit and freeze chance.

weapons.name: Chaos Rune
weapons.caption: Speed and Duration affect the number of hit boxes instead.
weapons.description:
Chaos Rune is a secret weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors that was introduced in Patch 1.14. It is unlocked by casting the spell "guinigigi".
Its evolution is Wicked Ruler, which requires Spellbinder at max level.

weapons.name: Cherry Bomb
weapons.caption: Throws a bouncing projectile. Explodes, sometimes.
weapons.description:
Cherry Bomb is a weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors that was introduced in Patch 0.2.13. It is the starting weapon of Yatta Cavallo. Other characters have a small chance to obtain it after Yatta Cavallo is unlocked. It can also be obtained from the Merchant in-game by spending 1,000, or by selecting it from Candybox.
Its evolution is Yatta Daikarin, which requires Chaos Rosalia and reaching level 80 while playing as Yatta Cavallo.
weapons.effects:
* Projectile has a 40% chance of exploding. This chance is increased by Luck.
* Scales with all stat bonuses

weapons.name: Clock Lancet
weapons.caption: Chance to freeze enemies in time.
weapons.description:
Clock Lancet is a non-damaging weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Iguana Gallo Valletto. It is unlocked by picking up an Orologion.
Its evolution is Infinite Corridor, which requires Silver Ring and Gold Ring at maximum level.
weapons.effects: Ignores Might, Amount, Speed, and Area.

weapons.name: Crimson Shroud
weapons.caption: Evolved Laurel. Caps incoming damage at 10. Retaliates when losing charges.
weapons.description: Crimson Shroud is an evolved weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Laurel, and requires Metaglio Left and Metaglio Right at max level.
weapons.effects:
* Ignores Speed and Duration.
* Armor and Curse scale with retaliatory damage.

weapons.name: Cross
weapons.caption: Aims at nearest enemy, has boomerang effect.
weapons.description:
Cross is a weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Krochi Freetto. It is unlocked by picking up a Rosary.
Its evolution is Heaven Sword, which requires Clover.
As a vampire-killing tool, it can be picked from Coat of Arms.

weapons.name: Dairy Cart
weapons.description:
Dairy Cart is a destructible, akin to light sources, that can be found in Dairy Plant. It also functions as a special weapon.
In the stage, there are rails in predetermined locations in the tileset, where the carts can spawn on their left end. When the player deals 40 damage to a cart, it gets launched at high speed towards the other end of the rail. Any enemies that come in contact with it are dealt 100 damage.
Dairy Carts have a special interaction with the Stalker in the Dairy Plant, causing it to drop a Treasure Chest when killed by a cart and trigger Toastie to appear when Exdash Exiviiq is already unlocked.
Dairy Cart can attack and defeat the otherwise intangible Stalkers in Dairy Plant before minute 30, causing them to drop lower quality chests.

weapons.name: Death Spiral
weapons.caption: Evolved Axe. Passes through enemies.
weapons.description:
Death Spiral is an evolved weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Axe, and requires the Candelabrador. Evolving it for the first time will unlock 500 as reward.
It is the starting weapon of Mask of the Red Death, Death, and one of the starting weapons of missingN▯.
Its union is Legacy of Death: Soul River, which also requires Dark Rift at max level.

weapons.name: Ebony Wings
weapons.caption: Bombards in a circling zone.
weapons.description:
Ebony Wings is a weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Exdash Exiviiq. It is unlocked by getting Peachone to Level 7.
Its union is Vandalier, which also requires Peachone at max level.
weapons.effects:
* Area orbits counterclockwise around the player
* Scales with all stat bonuses

weapons.name: Eight The Sparrow
weapons.caption: Fires quickly in four fixed directions.
weapons.description:
Eight The Sparrow is a weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors that was introduced in Patch 0.3.2. It is one of the starting weapons of Pugnala Provola. It is unlocked by surviving 15 minutes as Pugnala Provola.
Its union is Phieraggi, which requires both Phiera Der Tuphello at max level and Tirajisú.

weapons.name: Embrace of Gaea
weapons.caption: Evolved Gaze of Gaea. Damage is increased while invulnerable. Retaliates.
weapons.description: Embrace of Gaea is an evolved weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors that was introduced in Patch 1.13. It is the evolution of Gaze of Gaea, and requires Parm Aegis. Evolving it for the first time will unlock 500 as reward.
weapons.effects:
* Ignores Speed.
* Retaliates.
* Damage increased while invulnerable.
* Has a 5% chance to defang enemies. This chance is increased by Luck.

weapons.name: Fire Wand
weapons.caption: Fires at a random enemy, deals heavy damage.
weapons.description:
Fire Wand is a weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Arca Ladonna, Wood Rod, and Gaibon. It is unlocked by destroying a total of 20 light sources.
Its evolution is Hellfire, which requires Spinach.

weapons.name: Flames of Misspell
weapons.caption: Emits cones of flames.
weapons.description:
Flames of Misspell is a weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors that was introduced in Patch 1.0. It is the starting weapon of Avatar Infernas. Other characters can obtain it after Avatar Infernas is unlocked.
Its evolution is Ashes of Muspell, which requires Torrona's Box at max level.

weapons.name: Fuwalafuwaloo
weapons.caption: Union of Vento Sacro and Bloody Tear. Critical hits might generate explosions.
weapons.description:
Fuwalafuwaloo is a weapon union from the base game version of Vampire Survivors that was introduced in Patch 0.7.2. It is the union of Vento Sacro at max level and Bloody Tear.
It is the starting weapon of Rose De Infernas.
weapons.effects:
*Scales with all stat bonuses.
*Luck increases crit chance.
*Scales with Move Speed when moving.
*Moving continuously increases Amount
*Restores 8 HP/attack and creates an explosion if it hits any enemies with a crit

weapons.name: Garlic
weapons.caption: Damages nearby enemies. Reduces resistance to knockback and freeze.
weapons.description:
Garlic is a weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Poe Ratcho and Bitterfly. It is unlocked by picking up five Floor Chicken.
Its evolution is Soul Eater, which requires Pummarola.
weapons.effects:
* Ignores Amount, Duration, and Speed.
* Increases knockback and decreases freeze resistance.

weapons.name: Gatti Amari
weapons.caption: Summons capricious projectiles. Might interact with pickups.
weapons.description:
Gatti Amari is a weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors that was introduced in Patch 0.5.0. It is the starting weapon of Giovanna Grana. It is unlocked by surviving 15 minutes as Giovanna Grana.
Its evolution is Vicious Hunger, which requires Stone Mask.
weapons.effects:
* Consumes pickups if they are left untouched which has unique effects on the cats
* Scales with all stat bonuses

weapons.name: Gaze of Gaea
weapons.caption: Might Defang enemies.
weapons.description:
Gaze of Gaea is a weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors that was introduced in Patch 1.13. It is the starting weapon of Gazebo. It is unlocked by not killing any chicken enemies and waiting for one minute in the starting area of The Coop.
Its evolution is Embrace of Gaea, which requires Parm Aegis.
weapons.effects:
*Ignores Speed.
*Has a 3% chance to defang enemies. This chance is increased by Luck.

weapons.name: Glass Fandango
weapons.caption: Stronger with movement, Orologions, and against frozen enemies.
weapons.description:
Glass Fandango is a weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors that was introduced in Patch 1.15. It is the starting weapon of She-Moon Eeta. It is unlocked by getting it to level 7.
Its evolution is Celestial Voulge, which requires Wings at max level.
weapons.effects:
* Ignores Speed and Duration.
* Scales with Move Speed when moving.

weapons.name: Gorgeous Moon
weapons.caption: Evolved Pentagram. Generates extra gems and gathers all of them.
weapons.description:
Gorgeous Moon is an evolved weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Pentagram, and requires Crown. Evolving it for the first time will unlock 500 as reward.
Its union is Venus Crescent, which also requires Summon Spirit Tornado at max level.

weapons.name: Greatest Jubilee
weapons.caption: Has a chance to summon light sources.
weapons.description: Greatest Jubilee is a weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors that was introduced in Patch 1.0. It is unlocked by defeating The Directer and watching the ending credits, however the player must obtain it during a run in a different map to unlock it in the Collection.
weapons.effects:
* Firework ignores Duration and Speed.
* Light show ignores Area, Speed, and Amount.
* Attack has 1% chance of spawning a light source and 5% to deal critical damage. These chances are increased by Luck.

weapons.name: Gunastrophe
weapons.caption: Evolved Ammo Appalate. Fire unorthodox projectiles at enemies in sight.
weapons.description: Gunastrophe is an evolved weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors that was introduced in Patch 1.14. It is the evolution of Ammo Appalate, and requires Bracer at max level.

weapons.name: Heaven Sword
weapons.caption: Evolved Cross. Can do critical damage.
weapons.description:
Heaven Sword is an evolved weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Cross, and requires Clover. Evolving it for the first time will unlock 500 as reward.
It is the starting weapon of Gains Boros.
Its union is Arch Angle, which also requires Grand Cross at max level.
weapons.effects: Ignores Duration. Luck increases critical chance

weapons.name: Hellfire
weapons.caption: Evolved Fire Wand. Passes through enemies.
weapons.description:
Hellfire is an evolved weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Fire Wand, and requires Spinach. Evolving it for the first time will unlock 500 as reward.
Its union is Kardía Phlegeton, which also requires Aura Blast at max level.

weapons.name: Holy Wand
weapons.caption: Evolution of the Magic Wand. Fires with no delay.
weapons.description:
Holy Wand is an evolved weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Magic Wand, and requires Empty Tome. Evolving it for the first time will unlock 500 as reward.
It is the starting weapon of Leda.
Its union is Spirit of Light, which also requires Summon Spirit at max level.

weapons.name: Infinite Corridor
weapons.caption: Evolved Clock Lancet. Halves enemies' health.
weapons.description:
Infinite Corridor is an evolved weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Clock Lancet, and requires Silver Ring and Gold Ring at max level.
It is the starting weapon of Chaos.
weapons.effects: Ignores Might, Speed, Amount, and Area.

weapons.name: Insatiable
weapons.description: Insatiable is a weapon introduced in the Tides of the Foscari DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the hidden starting weapon of Je-Ne-Viv, and it can also be obtained with any character after equipping Victorian Horror (XVIII).
weapons.effects:
* Ignores Area, Speed, Duration, and Amount.
* Scales with Greed and Magnet.

weapons.name: King Bible
weapons.caption: Orbits around the character.
weapons.description:
King Bible is a weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Dommario. It is unlocked by default.
Its evolution is Unholy Vespers, which requires Spellbinder.
As a vampire-killing tool, it can be picked from Coat of Arms.
weapons.effects:
*Cooldown starts when active Duration ends
* Scales with all stat bonuses

weapons.name: Knife
weapons.caption: Fires quickly in the faced direction.
weapons.description:
Knife is a weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Gennaro Belpaese, and one of the optional starting weapons of Zephyr. It is unlocked by default.
Its evolution is Thousand Edge, which requires Bracer.
As a vampire-killing tool, it can be picked from Coat of Arms.

weapons.name: Kyra-Stones
weapons.caption: Evolved Magi-Stone. Damage increases when Player Level is above 80. Amount increases with visible enemies.
weapons.description:
Kyra-Stones is an evolved weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors that was introduced in Patch 1.14. It is the evolution of Magi-Stone, and requires Karoma's Mana. It is the starting weapon of Secretino Dagsson.
Its union is Shimmering Sands, which also requires Descent Into Misery.

weapons.name: La Borra
weapons.caption: Evolved Santa water. Damaging zones follow you and grow when they move.
weapons.description:
La Borra is an evolved weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Santa Water, and requires Attractorb. Evolving it for the first time will unlock 500 as reward.
Its union is Hydro Pump Climax, which also requires Hydro Storm at max level.
weapons.effects: Scales with all stat bonuses and Move Speed.

weapons.name: La Robba
weapons.caption: Generates bouncing projectiles.
weapons.description: La Robba is a weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors that was introduced in Patch 0.7.3. It is the starting weapon of Sir Ambrojoe. Other characters have a small chance to obtain it after Sir Ambrojoe is unlocked. It can also be obtained from the Merchant in-game by spending 1,000, or by selecting it from the Candybox.

weapons.name: Laurel
weapons.caption: Shields from damage while active.
weapons.description:
Laurel is a non-damaging weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Divano Thelma. It is unlocked by default.
Its evolution is Crimson Shroud, which requires Metaglio Left and Metaglio Right at maximum level.

weapons.name: Lightning Ring
weapons.caption: Strikes at random enemies.
weapons.description:
Lightning Ring is a weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Porta Ladonna and Wood Rod. It is unlocked by defeating a total of 5,000 enemies.
Its evolution is Thunder Loop, which requires Duplicator.
As a vampire-killing tool, it can be picked from Coat of Arms.

weapons.name: Mace
weapons.caption: Amount affects number of hits.
weapons.description:
Mace is a weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Hector. It is unlocked by inflicting a total of 50,000 damage with it.
It can be evolved into Stamazza with max level Hollow Heart. Evolving it after obtaining Black Disk unlocks Isaac as playable character.
As a magic weapon, it can be picked from Spectral Sword.

weapons.name: Magi-Stone
weapons.caption: Deals fixed damage based on Weapon Level.
weapons.description:
Magi-Stone is a weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors that was introduced in Patch 1.14. It is the starting weapon of Chula-Reh.
Magi-Stone can be found as stage item in Westwoods. It is unlocked by upgrading it to level 7.
Its evolution is Kyra-Stones, which requires Karoma's Mana. Evolving it will unlock 500 as reward.

weapons.name: Magic Wand
weapons.caption: Fires at the nearest enemy.
weapons.description:
Magic Wand is a weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Imelda Belpaese, and one of the starting weapons of Wood Rod. It is unlocked by default.
Its evolution is Holy Wand, which requires Empty Tome.

weapons.name: Mannajja
weapons.caption: Evolved Song of Mana. Might slow enemies down.
weapons.description:
Mannajja is an evolved weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Song of Mana, and requires Skull O'Maniac. Evolving it for the first time will unlock 500 as reward.
Its union is Dies Irae, which also requires Arrow of Goth at max level.

weapons.name: Mazo Familiar
weapons.caption: Evolved Pako Battiliar. Damage and Amount affected by Max Health.
weapons.description:
The Mazo Familiar is an evolved weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors that was introduced in Patch 1.9.0. It is the evolution of Pako Battiliar, and requires the Hollow Heart at max level.
It is the starting weapon of Bats Bats Bats.

weapons.name: Miracle of Multiplication
weapons.caption: Summons all tuna forms used this run, splitting all level up bonuses evenly. Cannot evolve.
weapons.description: Miracle of Multiplication is an evolved weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors that was introduced in Patch 1.15. It can be selected from Penshin Fatcha after evolving six or more times.

weapons.description:

weapons.name: NO FUTURE

weapons.description:
NO FUTURE is an evolved weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Runetracer, and requires Armor. Evolving it for the first time will unlock 500 as reward.
It is the starting weapon of Gyoruntin.
Its union is Carnage Heart, which also requires Troll Bomb at max level.

*Explodes when being hit by an enemy.
*Cooldown starts when active duration ends.
*Scales with all stat bonuses.

weapons.name: Pako Battiliar
weapons.caption: May retaliate when losing health.
weapons.description:
The Pako Battiliar is a weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors that was introduced in Patch 1.9.0. It is unlocked by defeating a total of 161,616 bats.
Its evolution is the Mazo Familiar, which requires the Hollow Heart at max level.
It is the starting weapon of Bat Robbert.

weapons.name: Peachone
weapons.caption: Bombards in a circling zone.
weapons.description:
Peachone is a weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Toastie. It is unlocked by surviving for 10 minutes in a stage as any character.
Its union is Vandalier, which also requires Ebony Wings at max level.
weapons.effects:
* Area orbits clockwise around the player
* Scales with all stat bonuses

weapons.name: Penshin Fatcha
weapons.caption: A selection of aquatic armaments that can evolve endlessly. (Default). Choose a new form. Level up bonuses from all previous forms carry over to the new form. (Evolved)
weapons.description:
Penshin Fatcha is a weapon selector from the base game version of Vampire Survivors that was introduced in Patch 1.15. It is the starting weapon of Para Kooleo. It allows the player to select one of the tuna forms, which includes:
* Tonno Subito
* Tonnado
* Tonn'omoto
* Tonn'oddeeo
* Tonne
* Unsurpassed
* Miracle of Multiplication (6+ evolutions)
Its evolution is itself, allowing the player to pick one of the six tuna forms. At six or more evolutions, it can be evolved into Miracle of Multiplication.
At first, only Tonno Subito can be selected, with the next option stating "Evolve Tonno Subito to unlock this form". When it evolves, it unlocks the next form and changes the next option from "???" to "Evolve. to unlock this form" accordingly, following the order of the list above until all six forms are unlocked. Unlike other weapon selectors, the player is not given a choice in skipping weapons. Furthermore, the previous options can be picked again immediately, stacking the stats bonuses from leveling up. All six forms have a max level of six, and do not require passive items to evolve.
When Penshin Fatcha is picked again or evolved into, unlocked options can be picked immediately without having to start from Tonno Subito.
At the sixth evolution (which does not require unlocking all the options), a unique option appears. Miracle of Multiplication attacks with all the options the players have picked at once and averages the levels for each weapon, but it stops gaining normal levels and the ability to evolve.
After evolving once, collecting Vacuums while any of the Penshin Fatcha forms is present also transforms them into Lavatrix Machinas. Lavatrix Machinas pull all items on the map into a vortex, slowly being collected by the character. It spins enemies around and can collect Treasure Chests, light sources, stage items, and pickups.

weapons.name: Pentagram
weapons.caption: Erases everything in sight.
weapons.description:
Pentagram is a weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors that was introduced in Patch 0.2.0. It is the starting weapon of Christine Davain. It is unlocked by surviving for 20 minutes in a stage as any character.
Its evolution is Gorgeous Moon, which requires Crown.
weapons.effects: Ignores everything but Cooldown and Luck.

weapons.name: Phas3r
weapons.caption: Generates thin damaging zones. High Amount scaling.
weapons.description:
Phas3r is a weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors that was introduced in Patch 1.9.0. It is the starting weapon of Space Dude. It is unlocked by getting it to level 7.
Its evolution is Photonstorm, which requires Empty Tome at max level.

weapons.name: Phiera Der Tuphello
weapons.caption: Fires quickly in four fixed directions.
weapons.description:
Phiera Der Tuphello is a weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors that was introduced in Patch 0.3.2. It is one of the starting weapons of Pugnala Provola. It is unlocked by surviving 10 minutes as Pugnala Provola.
Its union is Phieraggi, which requires both Eight The Sparrow at max level and Tirajisú.

weapons.name: Phieraggi
weapons.caption: Union of Phiera Der Tuphello and Eight The Sparrow. Scales with Revivals.
weapons.description: Phieraggi is a weapon union from the base game version of Vampire Survivors that was introduced in Patch 0.3.2. It is the union of Phiera Der Tuphello and Eight The Sparrow, and requires Tirajisú. Evolving it for the first time will unlock 500 as reward.
weapons.effects:
*Ignores Duration.
*Acquisition will free a weapon slot.

weapons.name: Photonstorm
weapons.caption: Evolved Phas3r. Multiplies number of projectiles by up to 5, depending on Luck.
weapons.description:
Photonstorm is an evolved weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors that was introduced in Patch 1.9.0. It is the evolution of Phas3r, and requires Empty Tome at max level. Evolving it for the first time will unlock 500 as reward.
It is the starting weapon of Space Dette.

weapons.name: Profusione D'Amore
weapons.caption: Evolved Celestial Dusting. Projectiles generate a chain explosion at fixed intervals.
weapons.description:
Profusione D'Amore is a morph from the base game version of Vampire Survivors that was introduced in Patch 1.7.0. It is the evolution of Celestial Dusting, and requires Chaos Altemanna relic and reaching level 80 while playing as O'Sole Meeo.
Alternatively, it can be obtained via Cosmic Finger rewards from Gold Fingers, or the Edition of O'Sole Meeo's Survarocchi.
weapons.effects:
* Bounces from terrain.
* Scales with all stat bonuses.

weapons.name: Rumba
weapons.caption: Pulls pickups and light sources.
weapons.description: Rumba is a weapon in Vampire Survivors. It is the hidden starting weapon of Persephone.

weapons.name: Runetracer
weapons.caption: Passes through enemies, bounces around.
weapons.description:
Runetracer is a weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Pasqualina Belpaese. It is unlocked by surviving 5 minutes as Pasqualina Belpaese.
Its evolution is NO FUTURE, which requires Armor.
As a vampire-killing tool, it can be picked from Coat of Arms.

weapons.name: Santa Javelin
weapons.caption: Duration affects Amount. Can deal critical damage.
weapons.description:
Santa Javelin is a weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors that was introduced in Patch 1.10. It is the starting weapon of Santa Ladonna. It is unlocked by attaining its maximum level of 7.
Its evolution is Seraphic Cry, which requires Clover at max level.
weapons.effects:
* Ignores Speed.
* Duration affects Amount.
* Luck increases crit chance.

weapons.name: Santa Water
weapons.caption: Generates damaging zones.
weapons.description:
Santa Water is a weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Suor Clerici. It is unlocked by default.
Its evolution is La Borra, which requires Attractorb.
As a vampire-killing tool, it can be picked from Coat of Arms.

weapons.name: Seraphic Cry
weapons.caption: Evolved Santa Javelin. Critical damage affected by Luck. Turns Rosaries into Weird Souls Purifiers.
weapons.description: Seraphic Cryis an evolved weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors that was introduced in Patch 1.1.0. It is the evolution of the Santa Javelin, and requires the Clover at max level. Evolving it for the first time will unlock 500 as reward.
weapons.effects:
* Ignores Speed.
* Duration affects Amount.
* Luck increases crit chance and damage.

weapons.name: Shadow Pinion
weapons.caption: Generates damaging zones when moving, strikes when stopping.
weapons.description:
Shadow Pinion is a weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors that was introduced in Patch 0.5.2. It is the starting weapon of Concetta Caciotta. It is unlocked by surviving 15 minutes as Concetta Caciotta.
Its evolution is Valkyrie Turner, which requires Wings.
weapons.effects: Scales with all stat bonuses and Move Speed when moving

weapons.name: Sole Solution
weapons.caption: Gift of Victory Sword. The more enemies are defeated, the stronger it grows.
weapons.description: Sole Solution is a weapon and a gift in Vampire Survivors that was introduced in Patch 0.11.0. It is the gift of the Victory Sword and requires Torrona's Box at max level. It does not replace the Victory Sword when obtained, and is instead given as a passive item without actually taking up any of the weapon or passive item slots.

weapons.name: Song of Mana
weapons.caption: Attacks vertically, passes through enemies.
weapons.description:
Song of Mana is a weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors that was introduced in Patch 0.3.0. It is the starting weapon of Poppea Pecorina. It is unlocked by surviving 15 minutes as Poppea Pecorina.
Its evolution is Mannajja, which requires Skull O'Maniac.

weapons.name: Sorbetto
weapons.effects:
* Scales with all stat bonuses.
* Freezes enemies.

weapons.name: Soul Eater
weapons.caption: Evolved Garlic. Steals hearts. Power increases when recovering HP.
weapons.description:
Soul Eater is an evolved weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Garlic, and requires Pummarola. Evolving it for the first time will unlock 500 as reward.
It is the starting weapon of Peppino.
Its union is Dark Frogamorphosis, which also requires Anura at max level.
weapons.effects:
*Ignores Amount, Duration, and Speed.
*Increases knockback and decreases freeze resistance.
*Has a chance to generate Little Hearts when killing enemies.
*Damage scales with damage healed.

weapons.name: Spirit Disturbance
weapons.caption: Evolved Unearthly Bolt. Always deals critical hits.
weapons.description: Spirit Disturbance is an evolved weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors that was introduced in Patch 1.15. It is the evolution of Unearthly Bolt, and requires Tirajisú at max level.

weapons.name: Stained Glass
weapons.description:
Stained Glass is a destructible, akin to light sources, that can be found in Cappella Magna. It also functions as a special weapon.
In the stage, there are window frames with a cross in predetermined locations in the tileset, where the Stained Glass can spawn. When the player deals 50 damage to a flashy window, it explodes into vertical beams of light. Any enemies that are caught in the explosion are dealt 130 Base Damage.

weapons.name: Super Candybox II Turbo
weapons.caption: Gift of Candybox. Allows to choose among a selection of advanced weapons.
weapons.description: Super Candybox II Turbo is a weapon selector and a gift from the base game version of Vampire Survivors that was introduced in Patch 0.11.3. It is the gift of Candybox.

weapons.name: Take Us Away
weapons.description:
Take Us Away, also called the Laborratory Train, is a stage mechanic activated by walking over levers found near the bottom of the map on Laborratory. It has the appearance of a steam engine train followed by coal and tank cars. It also functions as a special weapon, and can also be summoned by Carrozza!.
Dealing a total of 25,120 damage with Take Us Away unlocks the bonus stage, Carlo Cart.
weapons.effects:
* Scales with all stat bonuses.
* Gains bonus flat damage based on Area, Speed, and Duration.

weapons.name: Thousand Edge
weapons.caption: Evolved Knife. Fires with no delay.
weapons.description:
Thousand Edge is an evolved weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Knife, and requires Bracer. Evolving it for the first time will unlock 500 as reward.
It is the starting weapon of Boon Marrabbio.
Its union is Million Cut, which also requires Valmanway at max level.

weapons.name: Thunder Loop
weapons.caption: Evolved Lightning Ring. Projectiles strike twice.
weapons.description:
Thunder Loop is an evolved weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Lightning Ring, and requires Duplicator. Evolving it for the first time will unlock 500 as reward.
Its union is Vjaya Sisters, which also requires Sword Brothers at max level.

weapons.name: Tonn'oddeeo
weapons.caption: Heavenly tuna. Level up bonuses focus on Amount.
weapons.description:
Tonn'oddeeo is a weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors that was introduced in Patch 1.15. It is the starting weapon of Para Kooleo (Tonn'oddeeo). It is unlocked as a starting option for Penshin Fatcha by evolving Tonn'omoto.
Its evolution is Penshin Fatcha, which does not require any passive item. It cannot evolve when Para Kooleo starts with Tonn'oddeeo.
As a tuna form, it can be picked from Penshin Fatcha.

weapons.name: Tonn'omoto
weapons.caption: Freshwater tuna. Level up bonuses focus on Cooldown.
weapons.description:
Tonn'omoto is a weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors that was introduced in Patch 1.15. It is the starting weapon of Para Kooleo (Tonn'omoto). It is unlocked as a starting option for Penshin Fatcha by evolving Tonnado.
Its evolution is Penshin Fatcha, which does not require any passive item. It cannot evolve when Para Kooleo starts with Tonn'omoto.
As a tuna form, it can be picked from Penshin Fatcha.

weapons.name: Tonnado
weapons.caption: Whipped tuna. Level up bonuses focus on Duration.
weapons.description:
Tonnado is a weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors that was introduced in Patch 1.15. It is the starting weapon of Para Kooleo (Tonnado). It is unlocked as a starting option for Penshin Fatcha by evolving Tonno Subito.
Its evolution is Penshin Fatcha, which does not require any passive item. It cannot evolve when Para Kooleo starts with Tonnado.
As a tuna form, it can be picked from Penshin Fatcha.

weapons.name: Tonne
weapons.caption: King-sized tuna. Level up bonuses focus on Area. Amount affects hit box frequency instead.
weapons.description:
Tonne is a weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors that was introduced in Patch 1.15. It is the starting weapon of Para Kooleo (Tonne). It is unlocked as a starting option for Penshin Fatcha by evolving Tonn'oddeeo.
Its evolution is Penshin Fatcha, which does not require any passive item. It cannot evolve when Para Kooleo starts with Tonne.
As a tuna form, it can be picked from Penshin Fatcha.

weapons.name: Tonno Subito
weapons.caption: Basic tuna. Level up bonuses focus on Speed.
weapons.description:
Tonno Subito is a weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors that was introduced in Patch 1.15. It is the starting weapon of Para Kooleo (Tonno Subito). It is unlocked by default as an option of Penshin Fatcha.
Its evolution is Penshin Fatcha, which does not require any passive item. It cannot evolve when Para Kooleo starts with Tonno Subito.
As a tuna form, it can be picked from Penshin Fatcha.

weapons.name: Tri-Bracelet
weapons.caption: Fires three projectiles at a random enemy.
weapons.description:
Tri-Bracelet is an evolved weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Bi-Bracelet (which is obtained by evolving Bracelet). This evolution does not require any passive items. Evolving it for the first time will unlock 500 as reward.
Its union is Lapiste Tepisto, which also requires Kaiser Knuckle at max level.

weapons.name: Unearthly Bolt
weapons.caption: Critical hits generate damaging zones. Revivals affect damage of consecutive critical hits.
weapons.description:
Unearthly Bolt is a weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors that was introduced in Patch 1.15. It is the starting weapon of Big Troubler. It is unlocked by defeating one Bat Dragon.
Its evolution is Spirit Disturbance, which requires Tirajisú at max level.

weapons.name: Unholy Vespers
weapons.caption: Evolved King Bible. Never Ends.
weapons.description:
Unholy Vespers are an evolved weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of King Bible, and requires Spellbinder. Evolving it for the first time will unlock 500 as reward.
Its union is Ninth Circle, which also requires Icebrand at max level.
weapons.effects:
* Cooldown no longer depends on Duration.
* Scales with all stat bonuses.

weapons.name: Unsurpassed
weapons.caption: Premium tuna. Level up bonuses focus on Might.
weapons.description:
Unsurpassed is a weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors that was introduced in Patch 1.15. It is the starting weapon of Para Kooleo (Unsurpassed). It is unlocked as a starting option for Penshin Fatcha by evolving Tonne.
Its evolution is Penshin Fatcha, which does not require any passive item. It cannot evolve when Para Kooleo starts with Unsurpassed.
As a tuna form, it can be picked from Penshin Fatcha.

weapons.name: Valkyrie Turner
weapons.caption: Evolved Shadow Pinion. Bigger, longer, faster, stronger.
weapons.description:
Valkyrie Turner is an evolved weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Shadow Pinion, requiring Wings. Evolving it for the first time will unlock 500 as reward.
Its union is Darkness Illusion, which also requires Svarog Statue at max level.
weapons.effects: Scales with all stat bonuses and Move Speed when moving.

weapons.name: Vandalier
weapons.caption: Union of Peachone and Ebony Wings.
weapons.description:
Vandalier is a weapon union from the base game version of Vampire Survivors that was introduced in Patch 0.2.9. It is the union of Peachone and Ebony Wings. Evolving it for the first time will unlock 500 as reward.
It is the starting weapon of Smith IV.
weapons.effects: Has two areas that circulate in both directions. Acquisition will free a weapon slot. Scales with all stat bonuses

weapons.name: Vento Sacro
weapons.caption: Stronger with continuous movement. Can deal critical damage.
weapons.description:
Vento Sacro is a weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors that was introduced in Patch 0.7.2. It is the starting weapon of Zi'Assunta Belpaese. It is unlocked by surviving 15 minutes as Zi'Assunta Belpaese.
Its union is Fuwalafuwaloo, which also requires Bloody Tear.

stats.label: Damage
stats.base: 2. Up to +5 flat damage from walking nonstop

weapons.effects:
* Scales with all stat bonuses.
* Luck increases crit chance.
* Scales with Move Speed when moving.
* Moving continuously increases damage.

weapons.name: Vicious Hunger
weapons.caption: Evolved Gatti Amari. Might turn anything into gold.
weapons.description:
Vicious Hunger is an evolved weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Gatti Amari, and requires Stone Mask. Evolving it for the first time will unlock 500 as reward.
It is the starting weapon of Sammy.
Its union is Power of Lire, which also requires Soul Steal at max level.
weapons.effects: Has a chance to transmute pickups into gold coins.

weapons.name: Victory Sword
weapons.caption: Strikes with a combo attack at the nearest enemy. Retaliates.
weapons.description:
Victory Sword is a weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors that was introduced in Patch 0.11.0. It is unlocked by defeating 100,000 enemies in a single run while playing as Queen Sigma.
Its gift is Sole Solution, which requires Torrona's Box at max level; Victory Sword will not be replaced by Sole Solution after obtaining it.
It is the starting weapon of Queen Sigma.

weapons.name: Water Veil
weapons.caption: Grows stronger every time the owner gains 4 levels (max 7 times).
weapons.description: Water Veil is a weapon in Vampire Survivors. It is the hidden weapon of Gekkojin.
weapons.effects: Obtained only as a hidden weapon through Survarots.

weapons.name: Whip
weapons.caption: Attacks horizontally, passes through enemies.
weapons.description:
Whip is a weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Antonio Belpaese. It is unlocked by default.
Its evolution is Bloody Tear, which requires Hollow Heart.
As a vampire-killing tool, it can be picked from Coat of Arms.

weapons.name: Wicked Ruler
weapons.caption: Evolved Chaos Rune. Exerts control over wild magical forces.
weapons.description: Wicked Ruler is an evolved weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors that was introduced in Patch 1.14. It is the evolution of Chaos Rune, and requires Spellbinder at max level.

weapons.name: Yatta Daikarin
weapons.caption: Evolved Cherry Bomb. Generates extra explosions that can deal critical Luck based damage.
weapons.description:
Yatta Daikarin is a morph from the base game version of Vampire Survivors that was introduced in Patch 1.5.0. It is the evolution of Cherry Bomb, and requires Chaos Rosalia relic and reaching level 80 while playing as Yatta Cavallo.
Alternatively, it can be obtained via Cosmic Finger rewards from Gold Fingers, or the Edition of Yatta Cavallo's Survarocchi.
weapons.effects:
* Projectile has a 100% chance of exploding. This chance is technically increased by Luck, but it always explodes, so in practice this does nothing.
* Scales with all stat bonuses

weapons.name: Cavendish
weapons.caption: Evolved Gros Michel. Always crits. Always explodes. Other weapons crit more often.

weapons.name: Celestial Booster
weapons.caption: Planets orbit around you. Damage increases by amount of coins collected this run.
weapons.description:
Celestial Booster is a weapon from the Ante Chamber DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Perkeo. It is unlocked by leveling it up to level 6.
Its evolution is Negative Space, which requires Outer Saboteur at max level.

weapons.name: Fibonacci Spritz
weapons.caption: Creates a spiral spray of fizzy water. Has a chance to fire another equipped weapon.
weapons.description:
Fibonacci Spritz is a weapon from the Ante Chamber DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Canio. It is unlocked by leveling it up to level 6.
Its evolution is Royal Flush, which requires Outer Saboteur at max level.

weapons.name: Gros Michel
weapons.caption: Flings curving bananas. 1 in 6 chance to critically hit and explode.
weapons.description:
Gros Michel is a weapon from the Ante Chamber DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Chicot. It is unlocked by leveling it up to level 6.
Its evolution is Cavendish, which requires Outer Saboteur at max level.

weapons.name: Infernolatro
weapons.caption: Creates a zone of flames in the faced direction. Empowered by enemy kills.
weapons.description:
Infernolatro is a weapon from the Ante Chamber DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Jimbo. It is unlocked by leveling it up to level 6.
Its evolution is NaneInferno, which requires Outer Saboteur at max level.

weapons.name: NaneInferno
weapons.caption: Evolved Infernolatro. Adds a second zone. Zone effects multiply when combined.
weapons.description: NaneInferno is an evolved weapon from the Ante Chamber DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Infernolatro, requiring Outer Saboteur at max level.

weapons.name: Negative Space
weapons.caption: Evolved Celestial Booster. Reveals secret planets. Planets occasionally turn negative.
weapons.description: Negative Space is an evolved weapon from the Ante Chamber DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Celestial Booster, requiring Outer Saboteur at max level. Evolving it for the first time will unlock 77,777 as reward.

weapons.name: Royal Flush
weapons.caption: Evolved Fibonacci Spritz. Has a 55% chance to fire 1, 2, 3 or 5 other weapons.
weapons.description: Royal Flush is an evolved weapon from the Ante Chamber DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Fibonacci Spritz, requiring Outer Saboteur at max level.

weapons.name: Sossoldi
weapons.caption: Projectiles improve based on amount of coins collected in the current run.
weapons.description: Sossoldi is a hidden special weapon in Vampire Survivors, being only available in the Ante Chamber DLC. It is only used by Outer Saboteur and can not be obtained normally.

stats.label: Pool Limit
stats.base: 100 (Gold Coin). 50 (Coin Bag, Big Coin Bag, Rich Coin Bag)

weapons.name: Blood Chalice
weapons.caption: Evolved Sanguine Star. Can glimmer the "Scarlet Harbinger" tech: damage affected by Greed, might steal hearts.
weapons.description:
The Blood Chalice is an evolved weapon from the Emerald Diorama DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Sanguine Star, requiring Stone Mask and Blood Rage tech. It is the starting weapon of Malevolent Door Spirit.
Fully evolving Blood Chalice unlocks Intuition.

weapons.name: Bullova
weapons.caption: Passes through enemies. Can glimmer the "Hell's Fury" tech.
weapons.description:
The Bullova is a weapon from the Emerald Diorama DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Dolores. It is dropped by Specter of Iwanaga-hime in Yomi (north-west world) in Emerald Diorama.
Its Evolution is the Falconwind, which requires the Skull O'Maniac and Hell's Fury tech. It is unlocked by evolving it.
As an Emerald Diorama weapon, it can be selected from Intuition.

weapons.name: Dayblade
weapons.caption: Evolved Lordstar. Can glimmer the "Life Sprinkler" tech.
weapons.description: The Dayblade is an evolved weapon from the Emerald Diorama DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Lordstar.

weapons.name: Divergence
weapons.caption: Evolved Hecaton Machine Gun. Can Glimmer the "Sunlight Shower" tech.
weapons.description: The Divergence is an evolved weapon from the Emerald Diorama DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Hecaton Machine Gun. Evolving it unlocks Eagle Gun starting weapon and solo skin for Formina Franklyn.

weapons.name: Dress Sword
weapons.caption: Evolved Fleuret. Can glimmer the "Shocking Rush" tech.
weapons.description:
The Dress Sword is an evolved weapon from the Emerald Diorama DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of the Fleuret, requiring Crystalline Carve tech.
Its Evolution is the Espada Ropera, which requires the Shocking Rush tech.

weapons.name: Eagle Gun
weapons.caption: Fires at nearby enemies. Can glimmer the "Falconfire" tech.
weapons.description:
The Eagle Gun is a weapon from the Emerald Diorama DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the second optional starting weapon of Formina Franklyn as well as the starting weapon for the Kugutsu "Boh" skin. It is unlocked by leveling it up to level 6.
Its Evolution is the Pendragon, which requires the Spinach and Falconfire tech. Fully evolving it (into max level Pendragon) unlocks Diva No. 5 as playable character.
As an Emerald Diorama weapon, it can be selected from Intuition.

weapons.name: Emerald Rapture
weapons.caption: Picks random enemies to teleport away, but they might not drop XP gems.
weapons.description:
The Emerald Rapture is a weapon from the Emerald Diorama DLC in Vampire Survivors.
Its Evolution is the Emerald Wave, which requires the Crown. It is unlocked by evolving it.
As an Emerald Diorama weapon, it can be selected from Intuition.
weapons.effects: Chance of striking affected by all stats.

weapons.name: Emerald Wave
weapons.caption: Evolved Emerald Rapture. Teleports any enemy on its path and they always drop their best XP gems.
weapons.description: The Emerald Wave is an evolved weapon from the Emerald Diorama DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Emerald Rapture.

weapons.name: Espada Ropera
weapons.caption: Evolved Dress Sword. Allows to glimmer the "Mega Thrust" tech.
weapons.description: The Espada Ropera is an evolved weapon from the Emerald Diorama DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of the Dress Sword.

weapons.name: Falconwind
weapons.caption: Evolved Bullova. Can glimmer the "Reverse Delta" tech.
weapons.description: The Falconwind is an evolved weapon from the Emerald Diorama DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Bullova.

weapons.name: Feather Spear
weapons.caption: Evolved Glaive. Can glimmer the "Stardust" tech.
weapons.description:
The Feather Spear is an evolved weapon from the Emerald Diorama DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Glaive, requiring Divine Lancer tech.
Its Evolution is the Lohengrin, which requires the Stardust tech.

weapons.name: Flamberge
weapons.caption: Throws spinning swords upwards. Can glimmer the "Bull Crush" tech.
weapons.description:
Flamberge is a weapon from the Emerald Diorama DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Final Emperor. It is dropped by the Malevolent Door Spirit in Grelon (South-East world) in Emerald Diorama.
Its Evolution is the Zweihander, which requires the Bull Crush tech.
As an Emerald Diorama weapon, it can be selected from Intuition.

weapons.name: Fleuret
weapons.caption: Speed affects damage. Can glimmer the "Crystalline Carve" tech.
weapons.description:
The Fleuret is a weapon from the Emerald Diorama DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is one of the two starting weapons of Tsunanori Mido. It is unlocked by leveling it up to level 6.
Its Evolution is the Dress Sword, which requires the Crystalline Carve tech, and can be evolved into Espada Ropera with Shocking Rush tech; Fully evolving it unlocks Splashers starting weapon and solo skin for Tsunanori Mido.
As an Emerald Diorama weapon, it can be selected from Intuition.

weapons.name: Galatyn
weapons.caption: Evolved Zweihander. Can glimmer the "Vandalize" tech.
weapons.description: The Galatyn is an evolved weapon from the Emerald Diorama DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Zweihander.

weapons.name: Gekkabijin
weapons.caption: Evolved Twin Dragon. Can glimmer the "Scattered Petals" tech.
weapons.description: The Gekkabijin (Japanese: 月下美人, princess of the night) is an evolved weapon from the Emerald Diorama DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Twin Dragon, requiring Karoma's Mana and Gravedigger tech.

weapons.name: Gilded Hand
weapons.caption: Evolved Pressure Point. Can glimmer the "Guanyin" tech.
weapons.description: The Gilded Hand is an evolved weapon from the Emerald Diorama DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Pressure Point.

weapons.name: Glaive
weapons.caption: Stabs in the faced direction. Can glimmer the "Divine Lancer" tech.
weapons.description:
The Glaive is a weapon from the Emerald Diorama DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Lita Caryx. It is dropped by Earth Dragon in Witchdom Pulchra (North-East world) in Emerald Diorama. It is unlocked by evolving it.
Its Evolution is the Feather Spear, which requires the Divine Lancer tech.
As an Emerald Diorama weapon, it can be selected from Intuition.

weapons.name: Hecaton Machine Gun
weapons.caption: Evolved Saber Machine Gun. Can glimmer the "Bombarding Fire" tech.
weapons.description:
The Hecaton Machine Gun is an evolved weapon from the Emerald Diorama DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Saber Machine Gun.
Its Evolution is the Divergence, which requires the Bombarding Fire tech. Fully evolving it unlocks Eagle Gun starting weapon and solo skin for Formina Franklyn.

weapons.name: Hydra Cannon
weapons.caption: Evolved Super Missile. Can glimmer the "Artificial Hailstorm" tech.
weapons.description:
The Hydra Cannon is an evolved weapon from the Emerald Diorama DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Super Missile.
Its Evolution is the Hyperion Bazooka, which requires the Artificial Hailstorm tech.

weapons.name: Hyperion Bazooka
weapons.caption: Evolved Hydra Cannon. Can glimmer the "Cosmic Rave" tech.
weapons.description: The Hyperion Bazooka is an evolved weapon from the Emerald Diorama DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Hydra Cannon.

weapons.name: Intuition
weapons.caption: Allows you to choose from a selection of weapons from Emerald Diorama.
weapons.description:
Intuition is a weapon selector from the Emerald Diorama DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Mr. S, and an optional starting weapon for Ameya Aisling. It allows the player to select one of the Emerald Diorama weapons, which includes:
* Fleuret
* Town Sword
* Splashers
* Flamberge
* Punch
* Kick
* Saber Machine Gun
* Super Missile
* Eagle Gun
* Khukuri
* Twin Dragon
* Bullova
* Sanguine Star
* Glaive
* Spirit Rings
* Emerald Rapture
__TOC__

weapons.name: Jetstream
weapons.caption: Evolved Khukuri. Critical hits may give temporary invulnerability. Can glimmer the "Kaleidoscope" tech.
weapons.description: The Jetstream is an evolved weapon from the Emerald Diorama DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Khukuri.

weapons.name: Khukuri
weapons.caption: Shadow clones strike nearby enemies. Can glimmer the "Moonfall Slash" tech.
weapons.description:
The Khukuri is a weapon from the Emerald Diorama DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Macha Alter Ego and Kugutsu "Komachi" skin. It is dropped by Iron Maiden in Avalon (South-West world) in Emerald Diorama.
Its Evolution is the Jetstream, which requires the Parm Aegis and Moonfall Slash tech.
As an Emerald Diorama weapon, it can be selected from Intuition.

weapons.name: Kick
weapons.caption: Deal more damage when at full health. Can glimmer the "Thunder Kick" tech.
weapons.description:
The Kick is a weapon from the Emerald Diorama DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the second optional starting weapon of Bonnie Blair. It is unlocked by leveling it up to level 6.
Its Evolution is the Triangle Kick, which requires the Pummarola and Thunder Kick tech. Fully evolving it (into max level Triangle Kick) unlocks Formina Franklyn as playable character.
As an Emerald Diorama weapon, it can be selected from Intuition.

weapons.name: Lohengrin
weapons.caption: Evolved Feather Spear. Can glimmer the "Triumvirate" tech: damage x3.
weapons.description: The Lohengrin is an evolved weapon from the Emerald Diorama DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Feather Spear.

weapons.name: Lordstar
weapons.caption: Evolved Town Sword. Can glimmer the "Airwave" tech: damage x5.
weapons.description:
The Lordstar is an evolved weapon from the Emerald Diorama DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Town Sword.
Its Evolution is the Dayblade, which requires the Airwave tech.

weapons.name: Pendragon
weapons.caption: Evolved Eagle Gun. Can glimmer the "Bounding Shot" tech.
weapons.description: The Pendragon is an evolved weapon from the Emerald Diorama DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Eagle Gun, requiring Spinach and Falconfire tech.

weapons.name: Pressure Point
weapons.caption: Evolved Punch. Can glimmer the "Shenlong Firefist" tech.
weapons.description:
The Pressure Point is an evolved weapon from the Emerald Diorama DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Punch.
Its Evolution is the Gilded Hand, which requires the Shenlong Firefist tech.

weapons.name: Punch
weapons.caption: Attacks sideways. Can glimmer the "Raksha" tech.
weapons.description:
The Punch is a weapon from the Emerald Diorama DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is one of the two starting weapons of Bonnie Blair as well as the starting weapon for the Kugutsu "Sukune" skin. It is unlocked by leveling it up to level 6.
Its Evolution is the Pressure Point, which requires the Raksha tech, and can be further evolved into Gilded Hand with Shenlong Firefist tech. Fully evolving it unlocks Kick starting weapon and solo skin for Bonnie Blair.
As an Emerald Diorama weapon, it can be selected from Intuition.

weapons.name: Pursuant Blades
weapons.caption: Evolved Splashers. Can glimmer the "Dual Torrent" tech.
weapons.description: The Pursuant Blades is an evolved weapon from the Emerald Diorama DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Splashers.

weapons.name: Rings of Calamity
weapons.caption: Evolved Spirit Rings. Also triggers the "Chaos Disaster" tech.
weapons.description: The Rings of Calamity is an evolved weapon from the Emerald Diorama DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Spirit Rings.

weapons.name: Saber Machine Gun
weapons.caption: Fires in the faced direction. Can glimmer the "Shockwave" tech.
weapons.description:
The Saber Machine Gun is a weapon from the Emerald Diorama DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is one of the two optional starting weapons of Formina Franklyn. It is unlocked by leveling it up to level 6.
Its Evolution is the Hecaton Machine Gun, which requires the Shockwave tech, and can be further evolved into Divergence with Bombarding Fire tech. Fully evolving it unlocks Eagle Gun starting weapon and solo skin for Formina Franklyn.
As an Emerald Diorama weapon, it can be selected from Intuition.

weapons.name: Sanguine Star
weapons.caption: Strikes at the nearest enemies. Can glimmer the "Blood Rage" tech: damage x2, area x2.
weapons.description:
The Sanguine Star is a weapon from the Emerald Diorama DLC of Vampire Survivors. It becomes one of the two optional starting weapons of Siugnas after fully evolving Town Sword. It is unlocked by leveling it up to level 6.
Its Evolution is the Blood Chalice, which requires the Stone Mask and Blood Rage tech. Evolving it unlocks Intuition.
As an Emerald Diorama weapon, it can be selected from Intuition.

weapons.name: Spirit Rings
weapons.caption: Triggers additional techs when Area, Speed, Duration, and/or Growth bonuses are at or above 155%.
weapons.description:
The Spirit Rings is a weapon from the Emerald Diorama DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Ameya Aisling.
Its Evolution is the Rings of Calamity, which requires any 5 passives to be at max level.
As an Emerald Diorama weapon, it can be selected from Intuition.

weapons.name: Splashers
weapons.caption: Duration affects damage. Can glimmer the "Dual Whirlwind" tech.
weapons.description:
The Splashers is a weapon from the Emerald Diorama DLC of Vampire Survivors. It becomes one of the two optional starting weapons of Tsunanori Mido after fully evolving Fleuret. It is unlocked by leveling it up to level 6.
Its Evolution is the Pursuant Blades, which requires the Spellbinder and Dual Whirlwind tech. Fully evolving it unlocks Bonnie Blair as playable character.
As an Emerald Diorama weapon, it can be selected from Intuition.

weapons.name: Sunlight
weapons.description:
Glimmers#Sunlight
Sunlight is a hidden weapon in Vampire Survivors. It is currently only used in the Emerald Diorama DLC by the followers of Lolo, Hiss, Meow, and Purr.

weapons.name: Super Missile
weapons.caption: Fires exploding projectiles. Can glimmer the "Ballistic Missiles" tech.
weapons.description:
The Super Missile is a weapon from the Emerald Diorama DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Diva No. 5. It is unlocked by leveling it up to level 6.
Its Evolution is the Hydra Cannon, which requires the Ballistic Missiles tech.
As an Emerald Diorama weapon, it can be selected from Intuition.

weapons.name: Town Sword
weapons.caption: Strikes in the faced direction. Can glimmer the "Swallow Slice" tech.
weapons.description:
The Town Sword is a weapon from the Emerald Diorama DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is one of the two optional starting weapons of Siugnas. It is unlocked by leveling it up to level 6.
Its Evolution is the Lordstar, which requires the Swallow Slice tech.
As an Emerald Diorama weapon, it can be selected from Intuition.

weapons.name: Triangle Kick
weapons.caption: Evolved Kick. Glimmers "Triple Dragon": damage affected by overheal total.
weapons.description: The Triangle Kick is an evolved weapon from the Emerald Diorama DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Kick. Leveling it up to level 8 unlocks Formina Franklyn as playable character.

weapons.name: Twin Dragon
weapons.caption: Attacks horizontally. Can glimmer the "Gravedigger" tech.
weapons.description:
The Twin Dragon is a weapon from the Emerald Diorama DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Diva No. 5 "Virginia" skin and Kugutsu "Musashi" skin. It is unlocked by leveling it up to level 6.
Its Evolution is the Gekkabijin, which requires the Karoma's Mana and Gravedigger tech.
As an Emerald Diorama weapon, it can be selected from Intuition.

weapons.name: Zweihander
weapons.caption: Evolved Flamberge. Can glimmer the "Absetzen" tech.
weapons.description:
The Zweihander is an evolved weapon from the Emerald Diorama DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Flamberge.
Its Evolution is the Galatyn, which requires the Absetzen tech.

weapons.name: Clear Asteroids
weapons.caption: Evolved Clear Debris. Amount creates cluster explosions.
weapons.description: Clear Asteroids is an evolved weapon from the Emergency Meeting DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Clear Debris, requiring Mini Guardian at max level. Evolving it for the first time will unlock 50000 as reward.

weapons.name: Clear Debris
weapons.caption: Generates projectile spawning zones that follow the player.
weapons.description:
Clear Debris is a weapon from the Emergency Meeting DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Guardian Pina. It is unlocked by reaching level 50 with Guardian.
It can be evolved into Clear Asteroids with Mini Guardian at max level. The passive item will be added to the pool of available items upon leveling up as soon as the weapon reaches level 2.

weapons.name: Crossed Wires
weapons.caption: Evolved Lucky Swipe. Attacks in up to four directions.
weapons.description: Crossed Wires is an evolved weapon from the Emergency Meeting DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Lucky Swipe, requiring Mini Engineer at max level.

weapons.name: Emergency Meeting (weapon)
weapons.caption: Evolved Report! Occasionally destroys all of one type of enemy.
weapons.description: Emergency Meeting is an evolved weapon from the Emergency Meeting DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Report!, requiring Mini Crewmate at max level.

weapons.name: Hats
weapons.caption: Throws cute bouncing projectiles with random properties.
weapons.description:
Hats is a weapon from the Emergency Meeting DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Horse. Other characters have a small chance to obtain it after Horse is unlocked. It can also be obtained from Merchant in-game by spending 1,000.
Mini Horse will be added to the pool of available items upon leveling up as soon as the weapon reaches max level. Unlike other Emergency Meeting weapons, Mini Horse is not used to evolve Hats.

weapons.name: Impostongue
weapons.caption: Evolved Sharp Tongue. Deals high damage to the strongest enemy and anything in its path.
weapons.description: Impostongue is an evolved weapon from the Emergency Meeting DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Sharp Tongue, requiring Mini Impostor at max level.

weapons.name: Just Vent
weapons.caption: Destroys or heavily damages enemies. Amount affects how many times it can trigger.
weapons.description:
Just Vent is a weapon from the Emergency Meeting DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Shapeshifter Nino. It is unlocked by surviving 15 minutes with Shapeshifter.
It can be evolved into Unjust Ejection with Mini Shapeshifter at max level. The passive item will be added to the pool of available items upon leveling up as soon as the weapon reaches level 2.

weapons.name: Lifesign Scan
weapons.caption: Restores HP based on Amount and Recovery.
weapons.description:
Lifesign Scan is a weapon from the Emergency Meeting DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Ghost Lino. It is unlocked by getting itself to level 7. It is also a stage item on Polus Replica.
It can be evolved into Paranormal Scan with Mini Ghost at max level. The passive item will be added to the pool of available items upon leveling up as soon as the weapon reaches level 2.

weapons.name: Lucky Swipe
weapons.caption: The amount of attacks is affected by Amount and by low luck.
weapons.description:
Lucky Swipe is a weapon from the Emergency Meeting DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Engineer Gino. It is unlocked by surviving 15 minutes with Engineer.
It can be evolved into Crossed Wires with Mini Engineer at max level. The passive item will be added to the pool of available items upon leveling up as soon as the weapon reaches level 2.

weapons.name: Paranormal Scan
weapons.caption: Evolved Lifesign Scan. Periodically grants a random stat boost for the rest of the run.
weapons.description: Paranormal Scan is an evolved weapon from the Emergency Meeting DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Lifesign Scan, requiring Mini Ghost at max level.

weapons.name: Report!
weapons.caption: Damages enemies and pushes them away.
weapons.description:
Report! is a weapon from the Emergency Meeting DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Crewmate Dino. It is unlocked by surviving 15 minutes with Crewmate.
Report! can be evolved into Emergency Meeting with Mini Crewmate at max level. The passive item will be added to the pool of available items upon leveling up as soon as the weapon reaches level 2.

weapons.name: Rocket Science
weapons.caption: Evolved Science Rocks. Triggers a finisher when the right conditions are met.
weapons.description: Rocket Science is an evolved weapon from the Emergency Meeting DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Science Rocks, requiring Mini Scientist at max level.

weapons.name: Science Rocks
weapons.caption: Generates zones that explode when touched by a player. Amount affects the number of explosion clusters.
weapons.description:
Science Rocks is a weapon from the Emergency Meeting DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Scientist Mina. It is unlocked by reaching level 50 with Scientist.
It can be evolved into Rocket Science with Mini Scientist at max level. The passive item will be added to the pool of available items upon leveling up as soon as the weapon reaches level 2.

weapons.name: Sharp Tongue
weapons.caption: Licks enemies in front of you. Damage multiplied by Recovery.
weapons.description:
Sharp Tongue is a weapon from the Emergency Meeting DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Impostor Rina. It is unlocked by surviving 15 minutes with Impostor.
It can be evolved into Impostongue with Mini Impostor at max level. The passive item will be added to the pool of available items upon leveling up as soon as the weapon reaches level 2.

weapons.name: Unjust Ejection
weapons.caption: Evolved Just Vent. Sucks in enemies.
weapons.description: Unjust Ejection is an evolved weapon from the Emergency Meeting DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Just Vent, requiring Mini Shapeshifter at max level. Evolving it for the first time will unlock 50000 as reward.

weapons.name: 108 Responsive Prayers
weapons.caption: Actually it's just 16. Damage affected by the difference between Curse and Luck.
weapons.description:
108 Responsive Prayers is a weapon in Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Jaman Jato ★.
Its union is Road to Heaven, which also requires 108 Bocce.

weapons.name: Ashella
weapons.caption: Can deal critical hits.
weapons.description:
Ashella is a weapon from the Legacy of the Bloodmoon DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Calogero Bloodmoon. It is unlocked by obtaining the blood rain. It can alternatively be unlocked in the Forbidden Scrolls of Morbane by casting the spell "armpit".
Its evolution is Bloodlust, which requires max level Duplicator.

weapons.name: Blacken Firmament
weapons.caption: Erases a random enemy, occasionally leaving a damaging tear in reality.
weapons.description:
Blacken Firmament is a weapon from the Legacy of the Bloodmoon DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Baal'Thasar. It can alternatively be unlocked in the Forbidden Scrolls of Morbane by casting the spell "illibbro".
Its evolution is Damnation, which requires Torrona's Box at max level.

weapons.name: Bloodlust
weapons.caption: Evolved Ashella. Critical damage affected by Amount.
weapons.description: Bloodlust is an evolved weapon from the Legacy of the Bloodmoon of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Ashella, requiring max Duplicator.

weapons.name: Cardinal Rain
weapons.caption: Evolved Scarlet Needle. Endless rain can hit in any location.
weapons.description: Cardinal Rain is an evolved weapon from the Legacy of the Bloodmoon DLC for Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Scarlet Needle and requires Pummarola at max level.

weapons.name: Damnation
weapons.caption: Evolved Blacken Firmament. Draws enemies to ruin.
weapons.description: Damnation is an evolved weapon in Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Baal'Thamut. It is the evolution of Blacken Firmament and max level Torrona's Box.

weapons.name: Descent Into Misery
weapons.caption: Cursed item. Amount affects Damage. Critical hits or changing movement direction ensure extra attacks.
weapons.description:
Descent Into Misery is a weapon from the Legacy of the Bloodmoon DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Nameless Fool. It can alternatively be unlocked in the Forbidden Scrolls of Morbane by casting the spell "itsfinallycomingtopc".
Its union is Shimmering Sands, which also requires Kyra-Stones.

weapons.name: Dust to Dust
weapons.caption: Evolved Incineration. Infernal ashes blow back, erasing enemies.
weapons.description: Dust to Dust is an evolved weapon from the Legacy of the Bloodmoon DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Incineration and max level Candelabrador. It can alternatively be unlocked in the Forbidden Scrolls of Morbane by casting the spell "cradledineternity".

weapons.name: FireBall
weapons.caption: Generates an expanding damaging zone. Damage multiplied by Area.
weapons.description:
FireBall is a weapon from the Legacy of the Bloodmoon DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is a starting weapon of Sargon. It can alternatively be unlocked in the Forbidden Scrolls of Morbane by casting the spell "fuocopalla".
Its union is FireStall, which also requires FireFall and FireWall at max level.

weapons.name: FireFall
weapons.caption: Strikes at the furthest enemy. Damage further multiplied by Might.
weapons.description:
FireFall is a weapon from the Legacy of the Bloodmoon DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is a starting weapon of Sargon. It can alternatively be unlocked in the Forbidden Scrolls of Morbane by casting the spell "fuocaduta".
Its union is FireStall, which also requires FireBall and FireWall at max level.

weapons.name: FireStall
weapons.caption: Union of Firefall, FireWall, and Fireball. Grows stronger after every singularity.
weapons.description: FireStall is a weapon union from the Legacy of the Bloodmoon DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Megalo Sargon. It is the union of FireFall, FireBall, and FireWall.

weapons.name: FireWall
weapons.caption: Generates a directional damaging zone. Greatly affected by Amount.
weapons.description:
FireWall is a weapon from the Legacy of the Bloodmoon DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is a starting weapon of Sargon. It can alternatively be unlocked in the Forbidden Scrolls of Morbane by casting the spell "fuocomuro".
Its union is FireStall, which also requires FireFall and FireBall at max level.

weapons.name: Forbidden Siren
weapons.caption: Evolved Screams from the Void. Pulls and defangs enemies.
weapons.description: Forbidden Siren is an evolved weapon from the Legacy of the Bloodmoon DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Screams from the Void and max level Attractorb.

weapons.name: Incineration
weapons.caption: Erases enemies in the faced direction.
weapons.description:
Incineration is a weapon from the Legacy of the Bloodmoon DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Ashtart.
Its evolution is Dust to Dust, which requires max level Candelabrador.

weapons.name: Road to Heaven
weapons.caption: Union of 108 Bocce and 108 Responsive Prayers. Activate 108 times to glimpse enlightenment.
weapons.description: Road to Heaven is a weapon union from the Legacy of the Bloodmoon DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the union of 108 Bocce and 108 Responsive Prayers.

weapons.name: Scarlet Needle
weapons.caption: Damaging needles pin the nearest enemy in place.
weapons.description:
Scarlet Needle is a weapon from the Legacy of the Bloodmoon DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Malice Bloodmoon. It is unlocked by surviving 15 minutes with Malice Bloodmoon. Alternatively, it can be unlocked in the Forbidden Scrolls of Morbane by casting the spell "eighthouse".
Its evolution is Cardinal Rain which requires Pummarola at max level.

weapons.name: Screams from the Void
weapons.caption: Unleash screams with high knockback. Retaliates.
weapons.description:
Screams from the Void is a weapon from the Legacy of the Bloodmoon DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Congregation. It is unlocked by getting it to level 7. It can alternatively be unlocked in the Forbidden Scrolls of Morbane by casting the spell "colorsoutofspace".
Its evolution is Forbidden Siren, which requires max level Attractorb.

weapons.name: Shimmering Sands
weapons.caption: Union of Kyra-Stones and Descent Into Misery. Quicksand drags enemies down to hell.
weapons.description: Shimmering Sands is a weapon union from the Legacy of the Bloodmoon DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the union of Descent Into Misery and Kyra-Stones.

weapons.name: 108 Bocce
weapons.caption: Actually it's just 8. Damage affected by the difference between Curse and Luck.
weapons.description:
108 Bocce is a weapon from the Legacy of the Moonspell DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of McCoy-Oni. It is unlocked by surviving 15 minutes with McCoy-Oni.
Its union is Road to Heaven, which also requires 108 Responsive Prayers.
weapons.effects:
* Difference between Luck and Curse increases damage.
* Ignores Speed, Duration, and Amount.

weapons.name: Argent Flow
weapons.description: Argent Flow is a weapon from the Legacy of the Moonspell DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Megalo Miang Moonspell. It is the evolution of Festive Winds, requiring Torrona's Box at max level.

weapons.name: Boo Roo Boolle
weapons.caption: Evolved Mille Bolle Blu. Projectiles can hit the same target more than once.
weapons.description: Boo Roo Boolle is an evolved weapon from the Legacy of the Moonspell DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Mille Bolle Blu, which requires the Spellbinder at max level. Evolving it for the first time will unlock 50000 as reward.

weapons.name: Echo Night
