weapons.caption: Evolved Summon Night. Also generates damaging zones below the character.
weapons.description: Echo Night is an evolved weapon from the Legacy of the Moonspell DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Summon Night, requiring Duplicator at max level.

weapons.name: Festive Winds
weapons.caption: Evolved Silver Wind. Weakens enemies defenses.
weapons.description:
Festive Winds is an evolved weapon from the Legacy of the Moonspell DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Silver Wind, requiring Pummarola at max level.
Its evolution is Argent Flow which requires max level Torrona's Box.
weapons.effects:
* Has a chance to generate little hearts when killing enemies.
* Scales with all stat bonuses.

weapons.name: Four Seasons
weapons.caption: Generates 4 explosions. Amount and Duration affect damage instead.
weapons.description:
Four Seasons is a weapon from the Legacy of the Moonspell DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Menya Moonspell.
Its evolution is Godai Shuffle, which requires Candelabrador at max level.
weapons.effects:
* Amount and Duration increase damage instead.
* Ignores Speed.

weapons.name: Godai Shuffle
weapons.caption: Evolved Four Seasons. Generates an additional explosion.
weapons.description: Godai Shuffle is an evolved weapon from the Legacy of the Moonspell DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Four Seasons, requiring Candelabrador at max level.
weapons.effects:
* Amount and Duration increase damage instead.
* Ignores Speed.

weapons.name: J'Odore
weapons.caption: Evolved Mirage Robe. Projectiles move and confuse enemies.
weapons.description: J'Odore is an evolved weapon from the Legacy of the Moonspell DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Mirage Robe, requiring Attractorb at max level.
weapons.effects:
* Projectile has 80% chance of exploding. This chance is increased by Luck.
* Scales with all stat bonuses.

weapons.name: LunarBight
weapons.caption: Has a chance to slow down enemies hit.
weapons.description:
LunarBight is a weapon in Vampire Survivors. Gekkojin can choose to start with it via skin selection.
Its union is LunarFlight, which also requires LunarMight and LunarSight at max level.
LunarBight can be unlocked by getting it to level 6 after obtaining it by overhealing by 64 health as Spiritoso.

weapons.name: LunarFlight
weapons.caption: Union of LunarMight, LunarSight, and LunarBight. Become one with the lunar glyphs.
weapons.description: LunarFlight is a weapon in Vampire Survivors. It is the union of LunarMight, LunarSight, and LunarBight at max level.

weapons.name: LunarMight
weapons.caption: Generates a damaging zone that slightly increases Might.
weapons.description:
LunarMight is a weapon in Vampire Survivors. It is unlocked by getting it to level 6. It is the starting weapon of Spiritoso.
Its union is LunarFlight, which also requires LunarSight and LunarBight at max level.

weapons.name: LunarSight
weapons.caption: Generates damaging zones that occasionally follow the character.
weapons.description:
LunarSight is a weapon in Vampire Survivors. Gekkojin can choose to start with it via skin selection.
Its union is LunarFlight, which also requires LunarMight and LunarBight at max level.
LunarSight can be unlocked by getting it to level 6 after obtaining it by overhealing by 64 health as Spiritoso.

weapons.name: Mille Bolle Blu
weapons.caption: Fires lingering projectiles.
weapons.description:
Mille Bolle Blu is a weapon from the Legacy of the Moonspell DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Gav'Et-Oni ★. Other characters have a small chance to obtain it after Gav'Et-Oni ★ is unlocked. It can also be purchased from the Merchant for 1,000.
Mille Bolle Blu's evolution is Boo Roo Boolle, which requires the Spellbinder at max level.

weapons.name: Mirage Robe
weapons.caption: Generates freezing mines with a chance to explode.
weapons.description:
Mirage Robe is a weapon from the Legacy of the Moonspell DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Babi-Onna. It is unlocked by surviving 15 minutes with Babi-Onna.
Mirage Robe can be evolved into J'Odore with Attractorb at max level. Evolving it unlocks McCoy-Oni as a playable character.
weapons.effects:
* Projectile has 30% chance of exploding. This chance is increased by Luck.
* Ignores Speed.

weapons.name: Muramasa
weapons.caption: Evolved Night Sword. Enables critical hits and combo finisher. Drains Health.
weapons.description: Muramasa is an evolved weapon from the Legacy of the Moonspell DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Night Sword, requiring Stone Mask at max level. Evolving it for the first time will unlock 50,000 as reward.
weapons.effects:
* Drains the character's health when used.
* Has a chance to generate little hearts when killing enemies.
* Ignores Speed and Duration.
* Luck increases crit chance.

weapons.name: Night Sword
weapons.caption: Retaliates with a bonus damage affected by Greed. Might steal hearts.
weapons.description:
Night Sword is a weapon from the Legacy of the Moonspell DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is unlocked by finding it in Mt.Moonspell. It is the starting weapon of Megalo Syuuto Moonspell.
Its evolution is Muramasa, which requires Stone Mask at max level.
weapons.effects:
* Has a chance to generate little hearts when killing enemies.
* Ignores Speed and Duration.

weapons.name: Silver Wind
weapons.caption: Defeated enemies might drop hearts.
weapons.description:
Silver Wind is a weapon from the Legacy of the Moonspell DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Miang Moonspell. It is unlocked by surviving 15 minutes with Miang.
Silver Wind can be evolved into Festive Winds with Pummarola at max level. Evolving it unlocks Menya Moonspell as playable character.
weapons.effects:
* Has a chance to generate little hearts when killing enemies.
* Scales with all stat bonuses.

weapons.name: Summon Night
weapons.caption: Generates damaging zones above the character.
weapons.description:
Summon Night is a weapon from the Legacy of the Moonspell DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Syuuto Moonspell. It is unlocked by surviving 15 minutes with Syuuto.
Summon Night can be evolved into Echo Night with Duplicator at max level. Evolving it unlocks Babi-Onna as a playable character.

weapons.name: Acerbatus
weapons.caption: Evolved Optical Shot. Damage is affected by the amount of defeated enemies.
weapons.description:
Acerbatus is an evolved weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Optical Shot, requiring Max level Karoma's Mana. Evolving it keeps Optical Shot as hidden weapon.
__TOC__

weapons.name: Alchemy Whip
weapons.caption: Grows stronger every time a boss enemy is defeated.
weapons.description:
The Alchemy Whip is a weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Leon Belmont, and is unlocked by surviving 6 minutes with him.
Its Evolution is the Vampire Killer, which requires the Tirajisú.
After obtaining the Black Disk, Evolving the Alchemy Whip unlocks Sara Trantoul as a playable character.
As a magic whip, it can be picked from Morning Star.

weapons.name: Alucard Shield
weapons.description:
The Alucard Shield is a weapon and a gift from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the gift of the Alucard Swords, requiring at least six evolved weapons, including the Alucard Swords, and at least six maxed out passives.
Warning: Weapons that are absorbed do not count for Unlocks that require evolving a specific weapon.

weapons.name: Alucard Spear
weapons.caption: Executes a spinning attack when changing horizontal direction.
weapons.description:
Alucard Spear is a weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Eric Lecarde. It is unlocked by inflicting a total of 30,000 damage with it.
It can be evolved into Thunderbolt Spear with Wings. Evolving it and Iron Ball unlocks Shanoa as a playable character.
As a magic weapon, it can be picked from Spectral Sword.

weapons.name: Alucard Swords
weapons.caption: Evolved Alucart Sworb. Apparitions of the sword's true bearer seek out enemies.
weapons.description:
Alucard Swords is an evolved weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Alucart Sworb, requiring Max level.
It can be evolved into Alucard Shield with Max any 6 evolutions, any 6 passives. Be careful as the weapons will be absorbed, though still active, making room for 5 new weapons.

weapons.name: Alucart Sworb
weapons.caption: Allegedly strikes at the nearest enemy.
weapons.description:
Alucart Sworb is a weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC for Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Alucard. It is unlocked by inflicting a total of 10,000 damage with it.
It can be evolved into Alucard Swords once fully leveled. Evolving it unlocks Christopher Belmont as playable character.
As a magic weapon, it can be picked from Spectral Sword.

weapons.name: Anura
weapons.caption: Summons frogs that damage enemies as they jump.
weapons.description:
Anura is a weapon introduced in the 2025 update of the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Drolta Tzuentes. It can be purchased from Master Librarian for 2,800.
Its union is Dark Frogamorphosis, which also requires Soul Eater.
As a spell, it can be picked from Belnades' Spellbook.

weapons.name: Arch Angle
weapons.caption: Union of Grand Cross and Heaven Sword. Central beam pulses when crosses pass through it.
weapons.description: Arch Angle is a weapon union introduced in the 2025 update of the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the union of Grand Cross at max level and Heaven Sword.

weapons.name: Arrow of Goth
weapons.caption: Critical hits maximise amount of projectiles.
weapons.description:
Arrow of Goth is a weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC for Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of the Alamaric Sniper, and can be purchased and unlocked from Master Librarian for 2,800.
Its union is Dies Irae, which also requires Mannajja.
As a magic weapon, it can be picked from Spectral Sword.

weapons.name: Aura Blast
weapons.caption: Generates explosions sideways.
weapons.description:
Aura Blast is a weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC for Vampire Survivors. It can be purchased and unlocked from Master Librarian for 2,800.
It is the starting weapon of Wind.
Its union is Kardía Phlegeton, which also requires Hellfire.
As a magic weapon, it can be picked from Spectral Sword.

weapons.name: Aurablaster Tip
weapons.caption: Evolved Vanitas Whip. Every 7th activation generates an explosion.
weapons.description: The Aurablaster Tip is an evolved weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the Evolution of the Vanitas Whip, requiring the Hollow Heart.

weapons.name: Belnades' Spellbook
weapons.caption: Allows you to choose from a selection of spells.
weapons.description:
Belnades' Spellbook is a weapon selector from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It becomes available at the start of a stage when unlocked and equipped by an eligible character. It allows the player to select one of the Ode to Castlevania spells (which needs to be unlocked first), which include:
* Raging Fire
* Ice Fang
* Gale Force
* Rock Riot
* Fulgur
* Keremet Bubbles
* Hex
* Refectio
* Summon Spirit Tornado and Anura
__TOC__

weapons.name: Burning Alcarde
weapons.caption: Creates a damaging aura when health is low.
weapons.description:
The Burning Alcarde is a weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is Eric Lecarde's skill that is used when he is on low health.
HP-Critical skill when his health reaches below 20%, where he becomes invulnerable for 20 seconds, gains -20% Cooldown, and gets a flame aura that deals damage to surrounding enemies. The skill may only be activated again after recovering all HP. Receiving fatal damage resulting in a game-over will not trigger the skill.

weapons.name: Bwaka Knife
weapons.caption: Evolved Curved Knife. Projectiles bounce forever until Duration expires.
weapons.description: Bwaka Knife is an evolved weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Curved Knife, requiring Bracer.

weapons.name: Carnage Heart
weapons.caption: Union of Troll Bomb and NO FUTURE. This one does in fact bounce.
weapons.description: Carnage Heart is a weapon union introduced in the 2025 update of the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the union of Troll Bomb at max level and NO FUTURE.

weapons.name: Centralis Custos
weapons.caption: Summons Cerberus' vengeful head. Boosts Armor, Recovery and Cooldown when damaged.
weapons.description:
Centralis Custos is a weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is unlocked by defeating 7,000 enemies with Cornell.
Its union is Trinum Custodem, which also requires Dextro Custos and Sinestro Custos at max level.

weapons.name: Claimh Solais
weapons.caption: Evolved Pocket Knife. Globally increases Might, Armor and Crit Damage for each enemy in sight.
weapons.description: Claimh Solais is an evolved weapon introduced in the 2025 update of the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Pocket Knife, requiring Torrona's Box at max level.

weapons.name: Clock Tower
weapons.caption: Union of Endo Gears, Peri Pendulum, Myo Lift, and Epi Heads.
weapons.description: The Clock Tower is a weapon union from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the union of Endo Gears, Peri Pendulum, Myo Lift, and Epi Head.
weapons.effects: Amount and Orologions found increase damage

weapons.name: Coat of Arms
weapons.caption: Allows you to choose from a selection of vampire-killing tools.
weapons.description:
The Coat of Arms is a weapon selector from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It becomes available at the start of a stage when unlocked and equipped by an eligible character. It allows the player to select one of the vampire-killing tools, which are:
*8 evolvable base game weapons: Whip, Axe, Knife, Santa Water, Runetracer, King Bible, Cross, and Lightning Ring
*8 evolvable Ode to Castlevania weapons: Curved Knife, Shuriken, Javelin, Iron Ball, Discus, Silver Revolver, Hand Grenade, and Wine Glass
*4 of the Master Librarian weapons: Svarog Statue, Troll Bomb, Hydro Storm, and Grand Cross (once unlocked)
__TOC__

weapons.name: Cocytus
weapons.description:
Cocytus is an evolved weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Ice Fang, requiring Max level Spellbinder. Evolving it keeps Ice Fang as a hidden weapon.
It is the starting weapon of Loretta Lecarde.

weapons.name: Confodere
weapons.caption: Attack nearby enemies. Speed affects damage.
weapons.description:
Confodere is a weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Shanoa. It is unlocked by defeating 1000 enemies with Shanoa.
It can be evolved into Vol Confodere at max level, which can be further evolved into Melio Confodere.
After obtaining Black Disk, Evolving Confedere unlocks Albus as playable character.

weapons.name: Crissaegrim Tip
weapons.description: The Crissaegrim Tip is an evolved weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of the Sonic Whip, requiring the Skull O'Maniac.

weapons.name: Cross Crasher Tip
weapons.caption: Evolved Platinum Whip. Every 7th activation also fires special projectiles.
weapons.description: The Cross Crasher Tip is an evolved weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of the Platinum Whip, requiring Clover.

weapons.name: Curved Knife
weapons.caption: Fires a spinning projectile at random enemy.
weapons.description:
Curved Knife is a weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Grant Danasty. Technically, it is unlocked upon getting it to level 1, but in practice (as all weapons start at that level), it unlocks when it's obtained for the first time.
It can be evolved into Bwaka Knife with Bracer.
As a vampire-killing tool, it can be picked from Coat of Arms.

weapons.name: Dark Frogamorphosis
weapons.caption: Union of Anura and Soul Eater. May actually eat enemies.
weapons.description: Dark Frogamorphosis is a weapon union introduced in the 2025 update of the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the union of Anura at max level and Soul Eater.

weapons.name: Dark Iron Shield
weapons.caption: Evolved Iron Shield. Critical hits retaliate with spinning swords.
weapons.description: Dark Iron Shield is an evolved weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Iron Shield, requiring Parm Aegis.

weapons.name: Dark Rift
weapons.caption: Generates vertical damaging zones.
weapons.description:
Dark Rift is a weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It can be purchased and unlocked from Master Librarian for 2,800. It is the starting weapon of Count Olrox.
Its union is Legacy of Death: Soul River, which also requires Death Spiral.

weapons.name: Darkness Illusion
weapons.caption: Union of Svarog Statue and Valkyrie Turner. Crimson clones dance with you in the flames.
weapons.description: Darkness Illusion is a weapon union introduced in the 2025 update of the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the union of Svarog Statue at max level and Valkyrie Turner.

weapons.name: Daybreaker Tip
weapons.description: Daybreaker Tip is an evolved weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Vibhuti Whip, requiring Candelabrador.

weapons.name: Death Hand
weapons.caption: Deadly digits
weapons.description:
The Death Hand is a weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is used by Megalo Death.
This weapon gives the user two giant skeletal hands that move in tandem with him and create large cracks in the ground that shake the screen and deal 65 base damage to enemies.

weapons.name: Dextro Custos
weapons.caption: Summons Cerberus' fiery head in faced direction.
weapons.description:
Dextro Custos is a weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is one of the starting weapon of Cornell. It is unlocked by upgrading it to Level 6. It can be found in Maze of Dracula's Castle (at the bottom of the Clock Tower) after unlocking Serpent Gate.
Its union is Trinum Custodem, which also requires Sinestro Custos and Centralis Custos at max level.

weapons.name: Dies Irae
weapons.caption: Union of Arrow of Goth and Mannajja. Alamaric Snipers rain down arrows, even more so on critical hit.
weapons.description: Dies Irae is a weapon union introduced in the 2025 update of the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the union of Arrow of Goth at max level and Mannajja.

weapons.name: Discus
weapons.caption: Fires a defensive projectile.
weapons.description:
Discus is a weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Maxim Kischine. Once Scorpion Gate is unlocked, it can be found at the balcony over Library of Dracula's Castle. It is unlocked by getting it to level 5.
It can be evolved into Stellar Blade with Max level Parm Aegis.
As a vampire-killing tool, it can be picked from Coat of Arms.

weapons.name: Dominus Agony
weapons.caption: Increases Might, Speed, Duration, and Area. Drains Health.
weapons.description:
Dominus Agony is a weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is unlocked by defeating 8,000 enemies with Barlowe.
Its union is Power of Sire, which also requires Dominus Anger and Dominus Hatred at max level.
As an ambiguous power, it can be picked from Ebony Diabologue.

weapons.name: Dominus Anger
weapons.caption: Fires a penetrating projectile. Drains health.
weapons.description:
Dominus Anger is a weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It can be picked up from in the area of the Ode to Castlevania stage. It is unlocked by upgrading it to level 6. It is one of the optional starting weapons of Barlowe.
Its union is Power of Sire, which also requires Dominus Hatred and Dominus Agony at max level.

weapons.name: Dominus Hatred
weapons.caption: Fires projectiles from above. Drains Health.
weapons.description:
Dominus Hatred is a weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It can be picked up from in the area of the Ode to Castlevania stage. It is unlocked by upgrading it to level 6. It is one of the starting weapons of Barlowe.
Its union is Power of Sire, which also requires Dominus Anger and Dominus Agony at max level.

weapons.name: Dragon Water Whip
weapons.caption: Every 7th activation fires a snaking dragon projectile.
weapons.description:
The Dragon Water Whip is a weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Trevor Belmont. It is unlocked by Surviving 10 minutes as Trevor Belmont.
Its Evolution is the Hydrostormer Tip, which requires the Attractorb. Evolving it unlocks Grant Danasty as playable character.
As a magic whip, it can be picked from Morning Star.

weapons.name: Ebony Diabologue
weapons.caption: Allows you to choose from a selection of ambiguous powers.
weapons.description:
Ebony Diabologue is a weapon selector from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It becomes available at the start of a stage when unlocked and equipped by an eligible character. It allows the player to select one of the Ode to Castlevania ambiguous powers, which includes:
*Confodere
*Optical Shot
*Sonic Dash
*Luminatio
*Umbra
*Globus
*Dextro Custos, Sinestro Custos and Centralis Custos
*Dominus Anger, Dominus Hatred and Dominus Agony
*Summon Spirit, Dark Rift, Sword Brothers, and Soul Steal (once unlocked)
__TOC__

weapons.name: Endo Gears
weapons.caption: Also triggers other clockwork weapons. Damage increased by Amount and currently found Orologions.
weapons.description:
Endo Gears is a weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors
Its union is Clock Tower, which requires Myo Lift, Peri Pendulum, and Epi Head at max level.

weapons.name: Epi Head
weapons.caption: Also triggers other clockwork weapons. Damage increased by Amount and currently found Orologions.
weapons.description:
Epi Head is a weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors
Its union is Clock Tower, which requires Endo Gears, Myo Lift, and Peri Pendulum at max level.

weapons.name: Familiar Forge
weapons.caption: Allows you to summon a familiar.
weapons.description:
Familiar Forge is a weapon selector from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It allows the player to select one of the Ode to Castlevania familiars. It is the starting weapon of Young Maria Renard.
__TOC__

weapons.name: Fulgur
weapons.caption: Strikes at fixed locations.
weapons.description:
Fulgur is a weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC for Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Yoko Belnades. It can be dropped by defeating the The Creature boss in the unlockable area near the Parm Aegis in the DLC stage. It is unlocked by evolving it.
It can be evolved into Tenebris Tonitrus with Max level Duplicator.
As a spell, it can be picked from Belnades' Spellbook.

weapons.name: Gale Force
weapons.caption: Fires light-hitting projectiles backwards.
weapons.description:
Gale Force is a weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC for Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Julia Laforeze. Once the Capra Gate is unlocked, the player can obtain it from defeating Zephyr (enemy) in the middle of the Clock Tower on the Ode to Castlevania stage. It is unlocked by evolving it.
It can be evolve into Pneuma Tempestas with Max level Bracer.
As a spell, it can be picked from Belnades' Spellbook.

weapons.name: Gemma Torpor
weapons.description:
Gemma Torpor is an evolved weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Rock Riot, requiring Max level Stone Mask. Evolving it keeps Gemma Torpor as a hidden weapon.
It is the starting weapon of Witch Actrise.

weapons.name: Globus
weapons.caption: Fires two bouncing projectiles. Amount affects Duration.
weapons.description:
Globus is a weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Saint Germain. It is unlocked by defeating 5,000 enemies with Saint Germain.
It can be evolved into Nitesco with Max level Empty Tome. Evolving it also unlock Julia Laforeze as a playable Character.

weapons.name: Grand Cross
weapons.caption: Summons holy light.
weapons.description:
Grand Cross is a weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It can be purchased and unlocked from the Master Librarian for 2,800. It is the starting weapon of Tera.
Its union is Arch Angle, which also requires Heaven Sword.
As a vampire-killing tool, it can be picked from Coat of Arms.

weapons.name: Guardian's Targe
weapons.caption: Summons defensive followers. Overhealing triggers additional follower's attacks.
weapons.description:
Guardian's Targe is a weapon from the Ode To Castlevania DLC for Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Maria Renard. It is unlocked by inflicting a total of 80,000 damage with it.
It can be evolved into Sacred Beasts Tower Shield with Pummarola. Evolving it unlocks Richter Belmont as playable character.
As a magic weapon, it can be picked from Spectral Sword.

weapons.name: Gungnir-Souris
weapons.caption: Evolved Trident. Critical hits also fire a damaging beam.
weapons.description: Gungnir-Souris is an evolved weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Trident, and requires Duplicator at max level.

weapons.name: Hand Grenade
weapons.caption: Fires an exploding projectile.
weapons.description:
Hand Grenade is a weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Soma Cruz. It is unlocked by getting it to level 7.
It can be evolved into The RPG with Max level Candelabrador. Evolving it unlocks Jonathan Morris as playable character.
As a vampire-killing tool, it can be picked from Coat of Arms.
Ignores Amount.

weapons.name: Hand of Vlad
weapons.caption: Bloody Hands
weapons.description: The Hand of Vlad is a weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is used by Megalo Dracula.

weapons.name: Hex
weapons.caption: Generates a moving damaging zone. Damage affected by Curse.
weapons.description:
Hex is a weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC for Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Elizabeth Bartley. It is unlocked by evolving it. Once Serpent Gate is unlocked, it can be dropped by the Mummy boss located near the east exit of the Maze.
Its Evolution is Nightmare, which requires the Skull O'Maniac at max level.
As a spell, it can be picked from Belnades' Spellbook.

weapons.name: Hydro Pump Climax
weapons.caption: Union of Hydro Storm and La Borra. It never rains but it pours.
weapons.description: Hydro Pump Climax is a weapon union introduced in the 2025 update of the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the union of Hydro Storm at max level and La Borra.

weapons.name: Hydro Storm
weapons.caption: Generates damaging waves based on Projectile Speed and Duration.
weapons.description:
Hydro Storm is a weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Atlantis Shrine Wizard, and can be purchased and unlocked from Master Librarian for 2,800.
Its union is Hydro Pump Climax, which also requires La Borra.
As a vampire-killing tool, it can be picked from Coat of Arms.

weapons.name: Hydrostormer Tip
weapons.caption: Evolved Dragon Water Whip. Every 13th activation generates damaging waves based on Projectile Speed and Duration.
weapons.description: The Hydrostormer Tip is an evolved weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the Evolution of the Dragon Water Whip, requiring the Attractorb.

weapons.name: Ice Fang
weapons.caption: Generates damaging zones in a straight line.
weapons.description:
Ice Fang is a weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Sypha Belnades. Ice Fang can be dropped from Brachyura in the stairwell area of the Ode to Castlevania stage. It is unlocked by evolving it.
It can be evolved into Cocytus with Max level Spellbinder.
As a spell, it can be picked from Belnades' Spellbook.

weapons.name: Icebrand
weapons.caption: Fires lingering projectiles. Might freeze enemies.
weapons.description:
Icebrand is a weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It can be purchased from Master Librarian for 2,800.
Its union is Ninth Circle, which also requires Unholy Vespers.
As a magic weapon, it can be picked from Spectral Sword.
It is the starting weapon of Frozenshade.

weapons.name: Iron Ball
weapons.caption: Damage affected by Armor.
weapons.description:
The Iron Ball is a weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of John Morris. It is unlocked by getting the Iron Ball to level 4.
Its Evolution is the Wrecking Ball, which requires the Armor. Evolving it and Alucard Spear unlocks Shanoa as playable character.
As a vampire-killing tool, it can be picked from Coat of Arms.

weapons.name: Iron Shield
weapons.caption: Retaliates by shooting lingering projectiles.
weapons.description:
Iron Shield is a weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC for Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Vincent Dorin. It is unlocked by dealing a total of 70,000 damage with it.
It can be evolved into Dark Iron Shield with Parm Aegis. Evolving it unlocks Mina Hakuba as playable character.
As a magic weapon, it can be picked from Spectral Sword.

weapons.name: Javelin
weapons.caption: Fires a penetrating projectile in a fixed direction.
weapons.description:
Javelin is a weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Jonathan Morris. It is unlocked by getting it to level 3.
Its evolution is Long Inus, which requires Spellbinder.
As a vampire-killing tool, it can be picked from Coat of Arms.

weapons.name: Jet Black Whip
weapons.caption: Strikes at the nearest enemy and generates a linear damaging zone.
weapons.description:
Jet Black Whip is a weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Christopher Belmont. It is unlocked by Surviving 14 minutes as Christopher.
It can be evolved into Mormegil Tip with Stone Mask. Evolving it unlocks Simon Belmont as playable character.
As a magic whip, it can be picked from Morning Star.

weapons.name: Jewel Gun
weapons.caption: Evolved Silver Revolver. Critical hits instantly kill enemies and turn them into jewels.
weapons.description:
Jewel Gun is an evolved weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of the Silver Revolver, requiring Karoma's Mana.
__TOC__

weapons.name: Kaiser Knuckle
weapons.caption: Throws a flurry of close-range punches.
weapons.description:
Kaiser Knuckle is a weapon introduced in the 2025 update of the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Morris Baldwin. It can be purchased from Master Librarian for 2,800.
Its union is Lapiste Tepisto, which also requires Tri-Bracelet.
As a magic weapon, it can be picked from Spectral Sword.

weapons.name: Kardía Phlegeton
weapons.caption: Union of Aura Blast and Hellfire. Calls forth a massive volcanic eruption.
weapons.description: Kardía Phlegeton is a weapon union introduced in the 2025 update of the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the union of Aura Blast at max level and Hellfire.

weapons.name: Keremet Bubbles
weapons.caption: Fires slow moving damaging zones.
weapons.description:
Keremet Bubbles is a weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC for Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Rinaldo Gandolfi. It is unlocked by evolving it.
Keremet Bubbles can be obtained by killing Keremet after activating his rune in the North West of the Ode to Castlevania Map.
Keremet Bubbles can be evolved into Keremet Morbus with Max level Armor.
As a spell, it can be picked from Belnades' Spellbook.

weapons.name: Keremet Morbus
weapons.description:
Keremet Morbus is an evolved weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Keremet Bubbles, requiring Max level Armor. Evolving it keeps Keremet Bubbles as a hidden weapon.
It is the starting weapon of Keremet.

weapons.name: Lapiste Tepisto
weapons.caption: Union of Kaiser Knuckle and Tri-Bracelet. Launches a barrage of stony fists.
weapons.description: Lapiste Tepisto is a weapon union introduced in the 2025 update of the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the union of Kaiser Knuckle and Tri-Bracelet at max level.

weapons.name: Legacy of Death: Soul River
weapons.caption: Union of Dark Rift and Death Spiral. Death becomes you.
weapons.description: Legacy of Death: Soul River is a weapon union introduced in the 2025 update of the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the union of Dark Rift at max level and Death Spiral.

weapons.name: Long Inus
weapons.caption: Evolved Javelin. Projectiles reappear after leaving the screen.
weapons.description: Long Inus is an evolved weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Javelin, and requires Spellbinder.

weapons.name: Luminatio
weapons.caption: Fires spinning projectiles made of light.
weapons.description:
Luminatio (means Illumination in Latin) is a weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Lisa Tepes. It is unlocked by defeating 3000 enemies with Lisa.
It can be evolved into Vol Luminatio with Max level Crown. Evolving it unlocks Shaft as playable character.

weapons.name: Meal Ticket
weapons.caption: Evolved Wine Glass. Soulful food deals Revival-based damage to unrefined palates.
weapons.description: Meal Ticket is an evolved weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Wine Glass, and requires Tirajisú at max level.

weapons.name: Melio Confodere
weapons.caption: Attack nearby enemies. Speed affects Damage.
weapons.description:
Melio Confodere is an evolved weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Vol Confodere, requiring max level.
Evolving Melio Confodere will unlock Albus as playable character after completing the main secret of Ode to Castlevania stage.

weapons.name: Million Cut
weapons.caption: Union of Valmanway and Thousand Edge. Slashes endlessly. Grows bigger with continuous movement.
weapons.description: Million Cut is a weapon union introduced in the 2025 update of the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the union of Valmanway at max level and Thousand Edge.

weapons.name: Moon Rod
weapons.caption: Evolved Star Flail. Projectiles are shot in the faced direction.
weapons.description: Sanctuary is an evolved weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Star Flail, requiring Max level Pummarola.

weapons.name: Mormegil Tip
weapons.description: Mormegil Tip is an evolved weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Jet Black Whip, requiring Stone Mask.

weapons.name: Morning Star
weapons.caption: Allows you to choose from a selection of magic whips.
weapons.description: The Morning Star is a weapon selector from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is unlocked by evolving all 8 magic whips, though this does not have to be done in a single stage.

weapons.name: Myo Lift
weapons.caption: Also triggers other clockwork weapons. Damage increased by Amount and currently found Orologions.
weapons.description:
Myo Lift is a weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors
Its union is Clock Tower, which requires Endo Gears, Peri Pendulum, and Epi Head at max level.

weapons.name: Nightmare
weapons.caption: Evolved Hex. Also triggers a negative energy zone that doubles Curse when stepped into.
weapons.description:
Nightmare is an evolved weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Hex, requiring Max level Skull O'Maniac. Evolving it keeps Hex as a hidden weapon.
It is the starting weapon of Succubus.

weapons.name: Ninth Circle
weapons.caption: Union of Icebrand and Unholy Vespers. Hell truly has frozen over.
weapons.description: Ninth Circle is a weapon union introduced in the 2025 update of the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the union of Icebrand at max level and Unholy Vespers.

weapons.name: Nitesco
weapons.caption: Evolved Globus. Fires a piercing energy beam in the faced direction.
weapons.description: Nitesco (Latin for "To Begin Shining") is an evolved weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Globus, requiring Max level Empty Tome. Walter Bernhard starts with this weapon.

weapons.name: Optical Shot
weapons.caption: Fires two penetrating projectiles.
weapons.description:
Optical Shot is a weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Albus. It is unlocked by defeating 2,000 enemies with Albus.
It can be evolved into Acerbatus with Max level Karoma's Mana. Evolving it will also unlock Barlowe as a playable character.

weapons.name: Peri Pendulum
weapons.caption: Also triggers other clockwork weapons. Damage increased by Amount and currently found Orologions.
weapons.description:
Peri Pendulum is a weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors
Its union is Clock Tower, which requires Endo Gears, Myo Lift, and Epi Head at max level.

weapons.name: Platinum Whip
weapons.caption: Every 3rd activation fires projectiles in fixed directions.
weapons.description:
The Platinum Whip is a weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Richter Belmont. It is unlocked by Surviving 18 minutes with Richter.
Its Evolution is the Cross Crasher Tip, which requires the Clover.
As a magic whip, it can be picked from Morning Star.

weapons.name: Pneuma Tempestas
weapons.description:
Pneuma Tempestas is an evolved weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Gale Force, requiring Max level Bracer. Evolving it keeps Gale Force as a hidden weapon.
It is the starting weapon of Stella Lecarde.

weapons.name: Pocket Knife
weapons.caption: Throws a short-lived knife in the faced direction.
weapons.description:
Pocket Knife is a weapon introduced in the 2025 update of the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Genya Arikado and Fake Grant. It can be purchased (and unlocked) from Master Librarian for 2,800.
Its evolution is Claimh Solais, which requires Torrona's Box at max.
As a magic weapon, it can be picked from Spectral Sword.

weapons.name: Power of Lire
weapons.caption: Union of Soul Steal and Vicious Hunger. Devours enemies with insatiable greed
weapons.description:
Power Of Lire is a weapon union introduced in the 2025 update of the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the union of Soul Steal at max level and Vicious Hunger.
The Master Librarian starts with it as a hidden weapon.

weapons.name: Power of Sire
weapons.caption: Union of Dominus Anger, Dominus Hatred, and Dominus Agony. Deals critical damage to anything in sight. Drains health.
weapons.description: Power of Sire is a weapon union from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the union of Dominus Anger, Dominus Hatred, and Dominus Agony.

weapons.name: Raging Fire
weapons.caption: Generates an exploding damaging zone.
weapons.description:
Raging Fire is a weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Charlotte Aulin. It is unlocked by evolving it.
It can be evolved into Salamender with Max level Spinach.
As a spell, it can be picked from Belnades' Spellbook.

weapons.name: Rapidus Fio
weapons.caption: Evolved Sonic Dash. Also triggers a single shield charge.
weapons.description: Rapidus Fio is an evolved weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Sonic Dash, requiring Max level Wings. It is the starting weapon of xsmall Master Librarian

weapons.name: Refectio
weapons.caption: Generates a damaging zone that also provides light healing.
weapons.description:
Refectio is a weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC for Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Mina Hakuba and Familiar. It is unlocked by evolving it.
Once Beast Gate is unlocked, Refectio can be dropped by Jiang Shi, the boss enemy located at the top of Cathedral (the top part of the far east building, next to the Clock Tower).
Refectio can be evolved into Sanctuary with max level Clover.
As a spell, it can be picked from Belnades' Spellbook.

weapons.name: Rock Riot
weapons.caption: Fires projectiles from a fixed location.
weapons.description:
Rock Riot is a weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC for Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Carrie Fernandez. It can be dropped by defeating the Behemoth boss in the north of starting area of the DLC stage. It is unlocked by evolving it.
Rock Riot can be evolved into Gemma Torpor with Max level Stone Mask.
As a spell, it can be picked from Belnades' Spellbook.

weapons.name: Ruler Sword Body
weapons.description: Ruler Sword Body is a weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the hidden starting weapon of Ruler Sword.

weapons.name: Rune Sword
weapons.caption: Evolved Tyrfing. Critical Damage also affected by Area, Speed, and Duration.
weapons.description: Rune Sword is a weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC for Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Tyrfing, requiring Spinach. It is the starting weapon of Joachim Armster.

weapons.name: Sacred Beasts Tower Shield
weapons.description: Sacred Beasts Tower Shield is an evolved weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Guardian's Targe, requiring Pummarola.

weapons.name: Salamender
weapons.description:
Salamender is an evolved weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Raging Fire, requiring Max level Spinach. Evolving it keeps Raging Fire as a hidden weapon.
It is the starting weapon of Dario Bossi.

weapons.name: Sanctuary
weapons.caption: Evolved Refectio. At fixed intervals, also fully heals characters and purifies all enemies in sight.
weapons.description: Sanctuary is an evolved weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Refectio, requiring Max level Clover. Evolving it keeps Refectio as a hidden weapon.

weapons.name: Shaft Orb
weapons.description:
The Shaft Orb is a weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. Shaft starts with it as a hidden weapon.
The Shaft Orb that is summoned when reaching critically low health deals 20 base damage and covers most of the screen around the player character. The skill may only be activated again after recovering all HP. Receiving fatal damage resulting in a game-over will not trigger the skill.

weapons.name: Shuriken
weapons.caption: Fires projectiles in the faced direction.
weapons.description:
The Shuriken is a weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Quincy Morris. It is unlocked by getting the weapon to level 2.
Its Evolution is the Yagyu Shuriken, which requires the Empty Tome.
As a vampire-killing tool, it can be picked from Coat of Arms.

weapons.name: Silver Revolver
weapons.caption: Fires a powerful projectile, six times.
weapons.description:
Silver Revolver is a weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Henry. It is unlocked by upgrading it to level 6.
It can be evolved into Jewel Gun with Karoma's Mana. Evolving it unlocks Cornell as a playable character.
As a vampire-killing tool, it can be picked from Coat of Arms.

weapons.name: Sinestro Custos
weapons.caption: Summons Cerberus' icy head in faced direction.
weapons.description:
Sinestro Custos is a weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is one of the starting weapon of Cornell. It is unlocked by upgrading it to Level 6. It can be found in Crystal Cave of Dracula's Castle after unlocking Serpent Gate.
Its union is Trinum Custodem, which also requires Dextro Custos and Centralis Custos at max level.

weapons.name: Sonic Dash
weapons.caption: Increases Move Speed by 10% per level and damages nearby enemies. Area and speed increases damage.
weapons.description:
Sonic Dash is a weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Nathan Graves. It is unlocked by defeating 6,000 enemies with Nathan Graves.
Sonic Dash can be found in Ode to Castlevania stage after unlocking Dracula, located in the middle of Sewer.
It can be evolved into Rapidus Fio with Wings at max level.

weapons.name: Sonic Whip
weapons.caption: Chance to instant kill based on curse.
weapons.description:
The Sonic Whip is a weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Sonia Belmont. It is unlocked by Surviving 8 minutes with Sonia.
Its Evolution is the Crissaegrim Tip, which requires the Skull O'Maniac.
As a magic whip, it can be picked from Morning Star.

weapons.name: Soul Steal
weapons.caption: Damages all enemies in sight and attempts to turn them into hearts.
weapons.description:
Soul Steal is a weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Jiangshi, and can be purchased and unlocked from Master Librarian for 2,800. Alucard starts with a hidden version of this weapon that activates upon filling his charge ability by standing still.
Its union is Power of Lire, which also requires Vicious Hunger.

weapons.name: Spectral Sword
weapons.caption: Allows you to choose from a selection of magic weapons.
weapons.description:
Spectral Sword is a weapon selector from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It becomes available at the start of a stage when unlocked and equipped by an eligible character. It allows the player to select one of the Ode to Castlevania magic weapons, which includes:
* Alucart Sworb
* Tyrfing
*Alucard Spear
* Trident
*Mace
*Star Flail
*Iron Shield
*Guardian's Targe
*Valmanway, Icebrand, Arrow of Goth, Aura Blast, Kaiser Knuckle and Pocket Knife (once unlocked)

weapons.name: Spirit of Light
weapons.caption: Union of Summon Spirit and Holy Wand. Fires homing spirits from a portal of light.
weapons.description: Spirit of Light is a weapon union introduced in the 2025 update of the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the union of Summon Spirit at max level and Holy Wand.

weapons.name: Spirit Tornado Tip
weapons.caption: Evolved Wind Whip. Every 7th activation summons a spirit that violently collects XP gems for you.
weapons.description: The Spirit Tornado Tip is an evolved weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the Evolution of Wind Whip, requiring the Crown.

weapons.name: Stamazza
weapons.caption: Evolved Mace. Has a catastrophically high critical damage multiplier.
weapons.description: Stamazza is an evolved weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Mace, requiring Hollow Heart at max level.

weapons.name: Star Flail
weapons.caption: Fires lingering projectiles. Damage multiplied by Recovery.
weapons.description:
Star Flail is a weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Sara Trantoul. It is unlocked by dealing a total of 60,000 damage with it.
It can be evolved into Moon Rod with Pummarola at max level. Evolving it unlocks Rinaldo Gandolfi as playable character.
As a magic weapon, it can be picked from Spectral Sword.

weapons.name: Stellar Blade
weapons.caption: Evolved Discus. Travels along walls. Deals critical damage if the user is invulnerable.
weapons.description: Stellar Blade is an evolved weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of the Discus, requiring Max level Parm Aegis.

weapons.name: Summon Spirit
weapons.caption: Fires a homing projectile.
weapons.description:
Summon Spirit is a weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It can be purchased and unlocked from Master Librarian for 2,800. It is the starting weapon of Blackmore.
Its union is Spirit of Light, which also requires Holy Wand.

weapons.name: Summon Spirit Tornado
weapons.caption: Summons spirits that will occasionally pick up XP gems for you.
weapons.description:
Summon Spirit Tornado is a weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Persephone, and it can be purchased and unlocked from Master Librarian for 2,800.
Its union is Venus Crescent, which also requires Gorgeous Moon.
As a spell, it can be picked from Belnades' Spellbook.

weapons.name: Svarog Statue
weapons.caption: Generates damaging zones when moving.
weapons.description:
Svarog Statue is a weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It can be purchased (and unlocked) from Master Librarian for 2,800.
Its union is Darkness Illusion, which also requires Valkyrie Turner.
As a vampire-killing tool, it can be picked from Coat of Arms.

weapons.name: Sword Brothers
weapons.caption: Grants a brief moment of Invulnerability and generates a damaging wave.
weapons.description:
Sword Brothers is a weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It can be purchased and unlocked from the Master Librarian for 2,800.
Alucard starts with a hidden version of this weapon that is activated upon reaching critical HP.
Its union is Vjaya Sisters, which also requires Thunder Loop.
weapons.effects: Ignores everything but Cooldown and Might.

weapons.name: Tenebris Tonitrus
weapons.caption: Evolved Fulgur. Also triggers ball lightnings.
weapons.description:
Tenebris Tonitrus is an evolved weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Fulgur, requiring Max level Duplicator. Evolving it keeps Fulgur as a hidden weapon.
It is the starting weapon of Galamoth.

weapons.name: The RPG
weapons.description:
The RPG is an evolved weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Hand Grenade, requiring Candelabrador at max level.
It is the starting weapon of Hammer.

weapons.name: Thunderbolt Spear
weapons.description: Thunderbolt Spear is an evolved weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Alucard Spear, requiring Wings.

weapons.name: Trident
weapons.caption: Strikes at fixed locations.
weapons.description:
Trident is a weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Isaac and Slogra. It is unlocked by inflicting a total of 40,000 damage with it.
Its evolution is Gungnir-Souris, which requires Duplicator at max level.
As a magic weapon, it can be picked from Spectral Sword.

weapons.name: Trinum Custodem
weapons.caption: Union of Dextro Custos, Sinestro Custos, and Centralis Custos.
weapons.description:
Trinum Custodem is a weapon union from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the union of Centralis Custos, Dextro Custos and Sinestro Custos. It is the starting weapon of Blue Crescent Moon Cornell.
Centralis Custos, Dextro Custos and Sinestro Custos must be level 6 before Trinum Custodem becomes available.
Carrie Fernandez can be unlocked by uniting  Dextro Custos,  Sinestro Custos, and  Centralis Custos into  Trinum Custodem.

weapons.name: Troll Bomb
weapons.caption: This one doesn't bounce.
weapons.description:
Troll Bomb is a weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It can be purchased and unlocked from the Master Librarian for 2,800. Cave Troll starts with this weapon.
Its union is Carnage Heart, which also requires NO FUTURE.
As a vampire-killing tool, it can be picked from Coat of Arms.

weapons.name: Tyrfing
weapons.caption: Has boomerang effect, can deal critical damage.
weapons.description:
Tyrfing is a weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC for Vampire Survivors. It is unlocked by inflicting a total of 20,000 damage with the Tyrfing. It is the starting weapon of Reinhardt Schneider.
It can be evolved into Rune Sword with Spinach. Evolving it also unlocks Henry as playable character.
As a magic weapon, it can be picked from Spectral Sword.

weapons.name: Umbra
weapons.caption: Fires spinning projectiles made of darkness.
weapons.description:
Umbra (meaning "shadow" in Latin) is a weaponfrom the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Shaft. It is unlocked by defeating 4,000 enemies with Shaft.
It can be evolved into Vol Umbra with Max level Attractorb. Evolving it unlocks Elizabeth Bartley as playable character.

weapons.name: Universitas
weapons.caption: Gift of Vol Luminatio and Vol Umbra. Meteors rain down on enemies at fixed intervals.
weapons.description: Universitas is a weapon and a gift from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the gift of Vol Umbra and Vol Luminatio, both at max level. It does not replace Vol Umbra nor Vol Luminatio when obtained.

weapons.name: Valmanway
weapons.caption: Fires faster when moving.
weapons.description:
Valmanway is a weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Hugh Baldwin. It can be purchased (and unlocked) from Master Librarian for 2,800.
Its union is Million Cut, which also requires Thousand Edge.
As a magic weapon, it can be picked from Spectral Sword.

weapons.name: Vampire Killer
weapons.caption: Evolved Alchemy Whip. Every 3rd activation fires additional projectiles. Intense sunlight incinerates boss enemies.
weapons.description: The Vampire Killer is an evolved weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of the Alchemy Whip, which requires the Tirajisú.

weapons.name: Vanitas Whip
weapons.caption: Strikes at the nearest enemy and generates a perpendicular damaging zone. Zone damage affected by MaxHealth.
weapons.description:
The Vanitas Whip is a weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Julius Belmont. It is unlocked by surviving 20 minutes as Julius.
Its Evolution is the Aurablaster Tip, which requires the Hollow Heart.
As a magic whip, it can be picked from Morning Star.

weapons.name: Venus Crescent
weapons.caption: Union of Summon Spirit Tornado and Gorgeous Moon. Love, Beauty and Light.
weapons.description: Venus Crescent is a weapon union introduced in the 2025 update of the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the union of Summon Spirit Tornado at max level and Gorgeous Moon.

weapons.name: Vibhuti Whip
weapons.caption: Strikes at the nearest enemy and generates a cluster of explosions.
weapons.description:
Vibhuti Whip is a magic whip line weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Juste Belmont. It is unlocked by surviving 16 minutes with Juste Belmont.
It can be evolved into Daybreaker Tip with Candelabrador. Evolving it after completing the main quest of Ode to Castlevania stage unlocks Maxim Kischine as playable character.
As a magic whip, it can be picked from Morning Star.

weapons.name: Vjaya Sisters
weapons.caption: Union of Sword Brothers and Thunder Loop. Lightning triggers sword explosions with brief Invulnerability.
weapons.description: Vjaya Sisters is a weapon union introduced in the 2025 update of the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the union of Sword Brothers at max level and Thunder Loop.

weapons.name: Vol Confodere
weapons.caption: Attack nearby enemies. Speed affects Damage.
weapons.description:
Vol Confodere is an evolved weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Confodere, requiring max level.
It can be evolved into Melio Confodere with max level.

weapons.name: Vol Luminatio
weapons.caption: Evolved Luminatio. Damage, Speed, Area, and Duration affected by Growth.
weapons.description:
Vol Luminatio (means 'Illumination Will' in Latin) is an evolved weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Luminatio, requiring max level Crown.
Universitas can be acquired as a gift after Maxing out both Vol Luminatio and Vol Umbra.

weapons.name: Vol Umbra
weapons.caption: Evolved Umbra. Damage, Speed, Area, and Duration affected by Magnet.
weapons.description:
Vol Umbra is an evolved weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Umbra, requiring max level Attractorb. It is the starting weapon of Graham Jones.
Universitas can be acquired as a gift after Maxing out both Vol Luminatio and Vol Umbra.

weapons.name: Wind Whip
weapons.caption: Damage affected by Growth
weapons.description:
Wind Whip is a weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Simon Belmont. It is unlocked by surviving 12 minutes with Simon Belmont.
Its evolution is Spirit Tornado Tip, which requires Crown.
As a magic whip, it can be picked from Morning Star.

weapons.name: Wine Glass
weapons.caption: Throws an exploding projectile.
weapons.description:
Wine Glass is a weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Vlad Tepes Dracula.
Its evolution is Meal Ticket, which requires Tirajisú at max level.
As a vampire-killing tool, it can be picked from Coat of Arms.

weapons.name: Wrecking Ball
weapons.caption: Evolved Iron Ball. Fires a very heavy projectile.
weapons.description: The Wrecking Ball is an evolved weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the Evolution of the Iron Ball, requiring the Armor.

weapons.name: Yagyu Shuriken
weapons.caption: Evolved Shuriken. Fires with no delay.
weapons.description: The Yagyu Shuriken is an evolved weapon from the Ode to Castlevania DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the Evolution of the Shuriken, requiring the Empty Tome.

weapons.name: Atmo-Torpedo
weapons.caption: Evolved Diver Mines. Creates damaging zones that attract enemies.
weapons.description:
Atmo-Torpedo is an evolved weapon from the Operation Guns DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Diver Mines, requiring Weapon Power-Up and Attractorb.
__TOC__

weapons.name: BFC2000-AD
weapons.caption: Evolved Blade Crossbow. Calls fourth divine intervention with a Luck-based frequency.
weapons.description:
BFC2000-AD is an evolved weapon from the Operation Guns DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Blade Crossbow, requiring Weapon Power-Up and Clover. Evolving it for the first time will unlock 50000 as reward.
__TOC__

weapons.name: Big Fuzzy Fist
weapons.caption: Evolved Metal Claw. Pummels the most powerful enemies in sight.
weapons.description: Big Fuzzy Fist is an evolved weapon from the Operation Guns DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is evolved from Metal Claw with Weapon Power-Up and Hollow Heart. Evolving it for the first time will unlock 50000 as reward.

weapons.name: Blade Crossbow
weapons.caption: Fires homing projectiles that spin in place when they hit.
weapons.description:
Blade Crossbow is a weapon from the Operation Guns DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Sheena Etranzi. It is unlocked by surviving 15 minutes with Sheena Etranzi.
Its evolution is BFC2000-AD, which requires Weapon Power-Up and Clover.

weapons.name: C-U-Laser
weapons.caption: Fires a piercing projectile in the faced direction.
weapons.description:
C-U-Laser is a weapon from the Operation Guns DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Lucia Zero. It is unlocked by surviving 15 minutes with Lucia Zero.
Its evolution is Pronto Beam, which requires Weapon Power-Up and Tirajisú.

weapons.name: Diver Mines
weapons.caption: Fires explosive projectiles that travel along walls.
weapons.description:
Diver Mines is a weapon from the Operation Guns DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Newt Plissken. It is unlocked by surviving 15 minutes with Newt Plissken.
Its evolution is Atmo-Torpedo, which requires Weapon Power-Up and Attractorb.

weapons.name: Fire-L3GS
weapons.caption: Evolved Fire Arm. Fires again when destroying a light source or destructible item.
weapons.description:
Fire-L3GS is an evolved weapon from the Operation Guns DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Firearm, requiring Weapon Power-Up and Candelabrador.
__TOC__

weapons.name: Firearm
weapons.caption: Fires spinning projectiles at the nearest enemy.
weapons.description:
Firearm is a weapon from the Operation Guns DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Brad Fang. It is unlocked by surviving 15 minutes with Brad Fang.
Its evolution is Fire-L3GS, which requires Weapon Power-Up and Candelabrador.

weapons.name: Homing Miss
weapons.caption: Fires exploding projectiles that home in on enemies.
weapons.description:
Homing Miss is a weapon from the Operation Guns DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Stanley. It is unlocked by surviving 15 minutes with Stanley.
Its evolution is Multistage Missiles, which requires Weapon Power-Up and Duplicator.

weapons.name: Long Gun
weapons.caption: Fires constantly in the faced direction.
weapons.description:
Long Gun is a weapon from the Operation Guns DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Bill Rizer. It is unlocked by surviving 15 minutes with Bill Rizer.
Its evolution is Prototype A, which requires Weapon Power-Up.

weapons.name: Metal Claw
weapons.caption: Cooldown is affected by missing health.
weapons.description:
Metal Claw is a weapon from the Operation Guns DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Colonel Bahamut. It is unlocked by surviving 15 minutes with Colonel Bahamut.
Its evolution is Big Fuzzy Fist, which requires Weapon Power-Up and Hollow Heart.
weapons.effects:
*Ignores Duration.
*Cooldown is affected by missing health.

weapons.name: Multistage Missiles
weapons.caption: Evolved Homing Miss. Projectiles split into smaller ones when they hit.
weapons.description:
Multistage Missiles is an evolved weapon from the Operation Guns DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Homing Miss, requiring Weapon Power-Up and Duplicator. Evolving it for the first time will unlock 50000 as reward.
__TOC__

weapons.name: Prism Lass
weapons.caption: Has a small chance to freeze enemies.
weapons.description:
Prism Lass is a weapon from the Operation Guns DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Probotector. It is unlocked by surviving 15 minutes with Probotector.
Its evolution is Time Warp, which requires Weapon Power-Up and Wings.

weapons.name: Pronto Beam
weapons.caption: Evolved C-U-Laser. Laser split into multiple beams when they hit.
weapons.description:
Pronto Beam is an evolved weapon from the Operation Guns DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of C-U-Laser, requiring Weapon Power-Up and Tirajisú.
__TOC__

weapons.name: Prototype A
weapons.caption: Evolved Long Gun. Calls forth 2 drones for support fire.
weapons.description:
Prototype A is an evolved weapon from the Operation Guns DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Long Gun, requiring Weapon Power-Up.
__TOC__

weapons.name: Prototype B
weapons.caption: Evolved Short Gun. Calls forth 2 drones for support fire.
weapons.description:
Prototype B is an evolved weapon from the Operation Guns DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Short Gun, requiring Weapon Power-Up and Bracer.
__TOC__

weapons.name: Prototype C
weapons.caption: Evolved Spread Shot. Calls forth 2 drones for support fire.
weapons.description:
Prototype C is an evolved weapon from the Operation Guns DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Spread Shot, requiring Weapon Power-Up and Empty Tome.
__TOC__

weapons.name: Short Gun
weapons.caption: Fires bursts of decaying projectiles horizontally.
weapons.description:
Short Gun is a weapon from the Operation Guns DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Lance Bean. It is unlocked by surviving 15 minutes with Lance Bean.
Its evolution is Prototype B, which requires Weapon Power-Up and Bracer.

weapons.name: Sonic Bloom
weapons.caption: Fires growing projectiles in the faced direction.
weapons.description:
Sonic Bloom is a weapon from the Operation Guns DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Browny. It is unlocked by surviving 15 minutes with Browny.
Its evolution is Wave Beam, which requires Weapon Power-Up and Armor.

weapons.name: Spread Shot
weapons.caption: Fires in a wide spread in the faced direction.
weapons.description:
Spread Shot is a weapon from the Operation Guns DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Ariana. It is unlocked by surviving 15 minutes with Ariana.
Its evolution is Prototype C, which requires Weapon Power-Up and Empty Tome.

weapons.name: Time Warp
weapons.caption: Evolved Prism Lass. May freeze, slow down, or DeFang enemies.
weapons.description:
Time Warp is an evolved weapon from the Operation Guns DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is evolved from Prism Lass with Weapon Power-Up and Wings. Evolving it for the first time will unlock 50000 as reward.

weapons.caption: Evolved Sonic Bloom. Charges up a more powerful auto-aimed blast when standing still.
weapons.description:
Wave Beam is an evolved weapon from the Operation Guns DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Sonic Bloom, requiring Weapon Power-Up and Armor.

weapons.name: Eskizzibur
weapons.caption: Attacks nearby enemies. Retaliates.
weapons.description:
The Eskizzibur is a weapon from the Tides of the Foscari DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Maruto Cuts. It is unlocked by surviving 15 minutes as Maruto Cuts.
Its Evolution is the Legionnaire, which requires the Armor at max level.

weapons.name: Flash Arrow
weapons.caption: Can deal critical damage. Amount affects damage instead.
weapons.description:
Flash Arrow is a weapon from the Tides of the Foscari DLC for Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Keitha Muort.
Flash Arrow can be evolved into Millionaire with Bracer at max level.

weapons.name: Legionnaire
weapons.caption: Evolved Eskizzibur. Generates additional projectiles that deal retaliatory damage.
weapons.description: Legionnaire is an evolved weapon from the Tides of the Foscari DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the Evolution of the Eskizzibur, requiring the Armor at max level.
weapons.effects: Scales with all stat bonuses and Move Speed.

weapons.name: Luminaire
weapons.caption: Evolved Prismatic Missile. Increases the value of gems and coins on the ground.
weapons.description: Luminaire is an evolved weapon from the Tides of the Foscari DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Prismatic Missile, and requires Crown at max level. Evolving it for the first time will unlock 50000 as reward.

weapons.name: Millionaire
weapons.caption: Evolved Flash Arrow. Fires additional projectiles based on Amount and when picking up gold coins.
weapons.description: Millionaire is an evolved weapon from the Tides of the Foscari DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Flash Arrow, requiring Bracer at max level. Evolving it for the first time will unlock 50,000 as reward.

weapons.name: Ophion
weapons.caption: Evolved Shadow Servant. Has a chance to instantly kill enemies.
weapons.description: Ophion is an evolved weapon from the Tides of the Foscari DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the evolution of Shadow Servant, requiring Skull O'Maniac at max level. Evolving it for the first time will unlock 50,000 as reward.
weapons.effects:
* Ignores Speed.
* Luck increases the chance of slowing down or insta-killing enemies.

weapons.name: Party Popper
weapons.caption: Throws bouncing projectiles.
weapons.description: Party Popper is a weapon from the Tides of the Foscari DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Rottin'Ghoul. Other characters have a small chance to obtain it after Rottin'Ghoul is unlocked. It can also be purchased from the Merchant for 1,000.

weapons.name: Prismatic Missile
weapons.caption: Generates explosions around the character. Affected by the first chosen Arcana between II, XIV, or XIX.
weapons.description:
Prismatic Missile is a weapon from the Tides of the Foscari DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Luminaire Foscari.
Its evolution is Luminaire, which requires Crown at max level.

weapons.name: Shadow Servant
weapons.caption: Has a chance to slow enemies down.
weapons.description:
Shadow Servant is a weapon from the Tides of the Foscari DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Genevieve Gruyère and Je-Ne-Viv.
Its evolution is Ophion, which requires Skull O'Maniac at max level.
weapons.effects:
* Scales with all stat bonuses.
* Luck increases the chance of slowing down enemies.

weapons.name: SpellStream
weapons.caption: Generates an expanding damaging zone. Damage multiplied by Area.
weapons.description:
SpellStream is a weapon from the Tides of the Foscari DLC of Vampire Survivors.
Its union is SpellStrom, which also requires SpellString and SpellStrike at max level.
weapons.effects:
* Ignores Amount.
* Damage multiplied by Area.

weapons.name: SpellStrike
weapons.caption: Stikes at the nearest enemy. Damage further multiplied by Might.
weapons.description:
SpellStrike is a weapon from the Tides of the Foscari DLC of Vampire Survivors.
Its union is SpellStrom, which also requires SpellString and SpellStream at max level.
weapons.effects:
* Ignores Area and Duration.
* Damage further multiplied by Might.

weapons.name: SpellString
weapons.caption: Strikes at nearby enemies. Damage multiplied by Speed.
weapons.description:
SpellString is a weapon from the Tides of the Foscari DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the starting weapon of Eleanor Uziron.
Its union is SpellStrom, which also requires SpellStream and SpellStrike at max level.
weapons.effects:
* Ignores Area and Duration.
* Damage multiplied by Projectile Speed.

weapons.name: SpellStrom
weapons.caption: Union of SpellString, SpellStream, and SpellStrike. Grows stronger after every singularity.
weapons.description:
SpellStrom is a weapon union from the Tides of the Foscari DLC of Vampire Survivors. It is the union of SpellString, SpellStream, and SpellStrike.
SpellString, SpellStream, and SpellStrike must be level 6 before SpellStrom becomes available.
Uniting it unlocks Maruto Cuts as playable character.
